articleTitle: Deep Learning based Approach for Cassava Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Cassava is a vital staple crop in numerous tropical countries, to enhance plant disease detection using deep learning architecture including ResNet, EfficientNet, Incetion V3 and simple CNN. By levering these advance model significant improve accuracy compared to previous methods. This approach addresses the pressing issue of food insecurity by efficiently identifying diseases in crops. Types of Cassava disease are Cassava Mosaic Disease (CMD), Cassava Green Mottle (CGM), Cassava Brown Streak Disease (CBSD), and Cassava Bacterial Blight (CBB), along with the presence of Whitefly. The proposed work uses Convolution Neural Network (CNN) to identify the leaf diseases to quickly identify the specific disease that is affecting the crop. CNN can automatically detect important features without any human supervision. A vast collection of labelled cassava leaf photos comprising multiple disease classes is utilized for training the CNN model. To advance deep learning architectures, our research integrates techniques for data augmentation and transfer learning to further enchance model performance.

articleTitle: Fortifying Digital Security: A Machine Learning and Explainable AI Framework for Password Strength Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the current era where almost anything is accessible over the internet, passwords have become most important to ensure security and authentication. To provide authentication many other mechanisms exist like smart locks, biometrics, voice recognition, face recognition, etc. but still, passwords exist as the widely preferred method for authentication because of its ease of use and as many people are familiar with passwords. With the ease of use that it comes with there is a possible threat of guessing the passwords that exists. Usually, the passwords are some patterns, names, important years, etc. These are sometimes repetitive or easily guessed by the attacker because of their simplicity, and having common and weak passwords. The proposed model is a machine-learning algorithms that classifies the passwords as weak, medium, and strong based on their strength. Machine learning models like Random Forest (RF) classifier, Logistic Regression, XGBoost (XGB), and Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM).

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis with Various Machine Learning Algorithms for Prediction of Liver Cirrhosis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper represents the comparative analysis for prediction of liver cirrhosis using various machine algorithms. In recent years, the liver diseases are becoming so fatal that more investigations are required to correctly diagnose the disease profile. In this regard, the machine learning algorithms provide a good platform for forecasting the liver cirrhosis diseases in the people coming hospitals with various symptoms. In this paper, confusion matrix, accuracy score, F1 score have been used as a decision tool for various machine learning algorithms including SVM(Support vector machine), Logistic regression, Random forest, KNN(K Nearest Neighbor), Gaussian Naïve Bayes. After smote re sampling the output feature, it has been observed that the Random forest has successfully predicted the liver cirrhosis with a F1 score of 0.82.

articleTitle: Blood Cancer Detection Leveraging Deep Learning Fusion Techniques: An Optimized Model Based on VGG16 and AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A severe and life-threatening illness, blood cancer calls for early discovery and accurate diagnosis to maximize patient outcomes. This work presents a hybrid deep learning model integrated via a late fusion technique using the strengths of two well-known convolutional neural networks models VGG16, and AlexNet architecture. Combining the deep feature extraction powers of the VGG16 network with the AlexNet-inspired model’s capacity to capture varying spatial hierarchies, the proposed model produces a thorough and quite accurate classification of many blood cell types. Combining the two models helps to produce a single feature representation, which is then passed via fully connected layers to do multi-class classification. The Adam optimizer helps to maximize the system; training runs over 100 epochs using early stopping to prevent overfitting. With notable gains in F1-scores, recall, and precision across several blood cell categories, The experimental results indicate that the suggested model attains an accuracy of ${9 8 \%}$. This model emphasizes the possibilities of hybrid deep learning models in medical diagnostics, especially for early blood cancer detection where timely intervention is essential for patient survival. This model might be very helpful to medical professionals, particularly in areas with limited access to specialist healthcare services, by providing a strong and automated tool for blood cancer detection.

articleTitle: Detection of the Crown of Thorns starfish using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The invasive Crown-of-Thorns starfish (COTS) poses a significant threat to coral reef ecosystems. Early detection and removal are crucial to mitigating their impact. This research proposes a YOLOv5-based object detection system to accurately identify and locate COTS in underwater images. By fine-tuning the YOLOv5 model with a dataset of COTS images, the system can effectively detect and classify COTS with high precision and recall. The output of the system includes bounding boxes and confidence scores for each detected COTS, enabling timely intervention and removal efforts. This research contributes to the conservation of coral reefs by providing a valuable tool for monitoring and controlling COTS populations. The proposed system can be integrated into underwater drones or diveroperated devices to facilitate efficient and accurate COTS detection and removal.

articleTitle: Detection of Autism Disorder using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The complex neurodevelopmental disorder known as autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is defined by limited, repetitive patterns of behavior, interests, or activities, as well as ongoing difficulties with social communication and engagement. Acknowledging the vital importance of proactive intervention, this project aims to address this critical concern. A multi-dataset approach is adopted, incorporating four different datasets for different age groups (Children, Adolescent, Young, Adults) to improve diagnostic accuracy. By leveraging Flask, an intuitive user interface is created where participants could easily access and complete the comprehensive questionnaire aimed at capturing ASD-related symptoms and behaviors. Monitoring, screening, and assessing a person’s development is crucial to diagnosing ASD as early as possible. This allows us to provide the right care and support for an autistic person, enabling them to realize their full potential. By integrating data from various age groups, ranging from childhood to adulthood, the project aims to develop a comprehensive understanding of ASD across the lifespan.

articleTitle: Cultivating Success using CNN-Powered Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a machine learning model, are included into a mobile application created using Flutter to offer a comprehensive analysis of plant recommendations using soil prediction for soil types in India. Using CNNs, users may take their own photographs or select ones from the gallery to analyse in order to accurately categorise soil. Based on the identified kind of soil, the application suggests plants that are suitable for cultivation, assisting farmers and gardeners in making informed selections. This research study covers the significance of soil analysis and plant selection in agriculture in detail. The methodology part covers the construction of the Flutter application as well as the implementation of the CNN model. The trial results highlight the system’s potential impact on agricultural productivity and sustainability while also demonstrating the system’s effectiveness in categorising soil and proposing plants. The study discusses the ramifications of the research findings as well as possible future prospects for computer vision and agriculture research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Record Security: Using Role-based Access Control, Digital Signatures, and RSA Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Medicare, the proposed web application provides a unique way to store medical records in a secure manner by encrypting and providing role-based access control, where doctors can view the records of all patients but patients can view only their respective record and doctors also have the option of accessing RSA encrypted chat and also a unique digital signature is embedded to each record for ensuring the integrity of records. This provides a better approach for medical records management. Session management and secure authentication has also been implemented for tracking the actions that occurred in the website. The encrypted records are then stored in MongoDB. Therefore, this web-application provides a better and secure way to manage and share healthcare records.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of Deep Learning Models in Predicting Brain Ischemic Stroke Risk using EEG Signals.
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Stroke is the third most common cause of fatalities worldwide. It’s a hazardous condition that may cut off blood flow to the brain and result in death, serious illness, or disability. In order to begin treatment early and reduce the death rate, an exact stroke prediction is essential. Electrical activity inside the brain is reflected in electroencephalography (EEG) data, which provide a non-invasive method of monitoring brain performing to detect abnormalities relating to stroke risk. The intention is to evaluate the way deep learning models predict the risk brain stroke using EEG signals. For training and validate the models, a large set of electroencephalogram (EEG) data from patients with different stroke risk levels was used Using neural network architectures, which include recurrent and convolutional neural networks (RNNs), intends to identify EEG data’s temporal and spatial features that are predictive of the emergence of a stroke.At the convolutional layer, preprocessed data is fed into the three-layer CNN-model. From the input data, the layer of convolution extracts features that are useful. after feature extraction, fully interconnected (FC) layers are used to process the features by changing their weights. RNNs are made to handle sequential data by keeping memory states, particularly LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) networks. RNN excels at recognizing sequential data’s In order to take benefit of both architectures, a hybrid approach which utilizes CNN for extraction of features and RNN for modeling sequences can be implemented. In order to simulate temporal dependencies, layers of CNN may first extract spatial information, which are then given to RNN layers. The hybrid algorithm achieved $\mathbf{9 0. 0 2 \%}$ accuracy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Neuro-Fuzzy Classification System for Identifying Emotions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A person’s facial expressions reveal a great deal about their emotional state. The field of automated facial expression recognition holds great significance in the context of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). The Wavelet Transform Features serve as the foundation for the suggested facial emotion identification technique. As texture characteristics, the image’s grey-level co-occurrence parameters and discrete wavelet transform image properties were employed. The neuro-fuzzy Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) is used for classification. Validation of the suggested methodology’s performance yields encouraging results that demonstrate the recognition system’s efficacy.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Detection of Multi-Step Cyber Attacks: Insights from the Multi-Step Cyber-Attack Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The rapid growth in the complexity of cyber threats has made using advanced detection techniques necessary, especially for multi-step cyber-attacks involving wellorchestrated operations aimed at infiltrating systems. This research study proposes a detailed analysis and detection approach for multi-step cyber-attacks with the Multi-Step Cyber-Attack Dataset. Rapidly use three machine learning algorithms, Random Forest, SVM, and KNN, to detect and examine attack patterns. Other evaluation metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, and the F1-score. All these measures are used to ensure comprehensiveness regarding algorithm performance assessment. The Random Forest method proved most effective and showed excellent accuracy and robustness in identifying complex, multi-step attack sequences. The research also highlights the effectiveness of Random Forest in cyberattack detection, underscoring rich datasets much like MultiStep Cyber-Attack Dataset, further improving cybersecurity research and practice.

articleTitle: Visual Impairment Navigation: Real-Time Contour Mapping with 3D Spatial Audio Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: To help the visually impaired navigate through their environment in real time, this research study proposes a novel navigation system. This navigation system works on various navigation algorithms for contour mapping, computer vision techniques for visual processing and deep learning models implemented using TensorFlow for obstacle recognition, OpenCV for real time visual input processing and Open AL for spatial audio mapping. All these technologies combine to create the “follow the beep” feature in integration with Unity 3D. While designing this navigation system factors such as user experience and navigation efficiency have been considered and therefore conventional methods have been implemented to do so.

articleTitle: Improving Single Image-based Face Morphing Attack Detection Rate with Image Pre-processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Morphing attack detection is nothing but person who can cross the border without any valid identity. Face morphing attack detection can be divided into two categories: S-MAD for Single Morph Attack Detection and D-MAD for Differential Morph Attack Detection. The proposed study in this research is mainly focused on pre-processing methods using various filtering approaches. Several filtering approaches are used to decrease noise from facial images in order to distinguish changing faces. In this paper, the non-local means filter, the gaussian filter, the low-pass filter, and a bilateral filter are analysed and compared. The performance and quality of Feature Extraction, Optimization, and Classification improves when the bilateral filter technique is applied for image preprocessing. The AMSL Face Morph picture dataset is collected via the Github Repository, and an experiment is carried out to evaluate the efficiency of bilateral filtering in removing noise from the image.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring System using Ensemble based Learning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One great tool that could potentially save lives is the Health Monitoring System. It uses transmitters to collect data, which it then wirelessly sends to a receiver. It is far more advantageous than the bulky machinery that many hospitals continue to use daily to review patient medical records. To forecast the disease stage, an ensemble model combining models such as Deep Boltzmann Machine Network (DBM), Deep Belief Network (DBN), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). In the experiment investigation, the DBM-DBM based ensemble model performs remarkably well, providing a much more compelling explanation and default prediction.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Low-Power XOR-XNOR Circuits: Emerging Technologies and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Exploring the frontier of digital electronics, this research evaluates XOR-XNOR circuits in light of advanced semiconductor technologies such as FinFET, TFET, and spintronics. We identify these technologies as robust alternatives to conventional CMOS circuits, rapidly approaching their scalability limits. This research study highlights the significance of enhancing power efficiency, minimizing delay, and optimizing overall circuit performance through strategic design interventions. This paper shows how to make XOR-XNOR circuit designs even better using hybrid logic configurations, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), and advanced power gating techniques. The research ventures into the potential of emerging paradigms like Quantum-Dot Cellular Automata (QCA), neuromorphic computing, and 3D integration. We project these technologies to revolutionize XOR-XNOR circuits, especially in applications that demand high performance and low power consumption, like AI and IoT devices. By integrating these novel technologies with conventional design methodologies, the study advocates for a transformative approach to developing the next generation of XOR-XNOR circuits. Energy-efficient computing will significantly advance with this integration, creating a new era in digital circuit design that utilizes both innovative technologies and established engineering practices.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics on Irritating Anxiety of Long COVID
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Big data and its analytics can perform in different areas of human society. The aim of this paper is to produce the irritating anxiety of Long COVID from different age groups of persons in Kottayam district, Kerala state, India. articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Renewable Solar Energy in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Solar energy is a clean, accessible, and unconsumable energy source. With the necessary infrastructure, a solar PV system delivers variable output based on solar irradiance. As power shortages are unavoidable in today’s modern civilization, which saw an increase in electrical energy use after the industrial revolution. Therefore, all industrialized countries, as well as many emerging ones like India, have been working on green energy initiatives to produce gadgets that are not only energy-efficient but also significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions. The end result is smart cities that revive the environment while keeping the nation’s economy and technology advancements moving at the same speed. Using photovoltaic (PV) systems in solar energy projects is one such important move that the world is considering.

articleTitle: Flood Risk Assesment System using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One of the most frequent natural disasters in the world, flooding affects millions of people annually and causes significant economic losses as well as human tragedies, with India bearing a disproportionate amount of the burden. Reducing these effects requires effective early warning systems, yet many vulnerable communities still struggle to make use of them. Scientists and programmers are using advances in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) to bridge this gap by creating a trustworthy flood prediction system. This state-of-the-art system aims to offer more cost-effective choices that perform better at predicting floods caused by precipitation. This prediction system’s primary job is to forecast potential flood events by utilizing previous rainfall data to create predictive models. The model looks at rainfall patterns specific to different locations to determine the likelihood of a flood event. Its growth depends on the utilization of extensive district-level rainfall information from India, which serve as the foundation for training and enhancing the prediction models. A range of machine learning (ML) techniques, such as XGBoost and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), are used to train predictive algorithms. These algorithms were chosen because of their ability to handle complex datasets and extract meaningful patterns that relate the amount of rainfall with the probability of floods. Through recurrent training and validation against past flood events, the models are improved to reliably determine whether a region is in danger of flooding based on measured rainfall amounts.

articleTitle: A Machine-Learning Approach to Detect Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Moreover, heart disease has kept on being the leading cause of death worldwide, hence the importance of coming up with different strategies for early detection and diagnosis. Machine learning algorithms have been found to be very efficient in diagnosing various cardiac diseases, through approaches such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, Neural Networks, and Logistic Regression. The materials of this research consist of a dataset that has various health markers, such as age, blood pressure, cholesterol level, and other clinical factors that are relevant to this issue. The Random Forest classifier was the only one with an incredible accuracy of 97.5% to outsmart the rest of the algorithms used. It also managed to record a 0.998 Area Under the Curve (AUC) score and F1, Precision, and Recall scores of $\mathbf{9 7. 5 \%}$. This finding highlights how machine learning models can help increase diagnostic accuracy and assist healthcare professionals in making better-informed decisions about patient management. In addition to contributing to the knowledge base on heart disease identification, this study also supports using innovative computing techniques in the clinics. By incorporating machine learning, we can significantly enhance early detection levels, enhancing patient outcomes and reducing healthcare expenses. This research formed a basis for subsequent studies concerning the effect of artificial intelligence on cardiovascular wellness

articleTitle: Data visualization of total harmonic distortion comparison of Cascaded H bridge multilevel inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: To fulfill the expectations of the load requirements, multilevel inverters are essential. Various researches focus to increase the level of the inverters, reduce the switches, and change the topologies to achieve higher output to drive loads efficiently. However, there are harmonic contents detected in the output voltage for all these multilevel inverters. Cascaded $\mathbf{H}$ bridge topology is chosen for analyzing all the inverters. Total harmonic distortion of five, seven, nine, eleven, thirteen, fifteen, nineteen, twenty one and twenty nine are compared and tabulated. This research proposes to focus on comparing the harmonics of these multilevel inverters and to understand the changes using data visualization techniques. Study proposes selection of higher level inverters to drive high speed drives.

articleTitle: Development of Near-Field Sensor for Detection and Characterization of Ice in Aerospace
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This study aims to develop a near-filed sensor using a Complementary Concentric Split Ring Resonator (CCSRR) operating at a resonance frequency of 4.303 GHz for the detection of ice, which can be installed in aircraft to detect ice formation on various critical parts of the aircraft and provide rapid and accurate real-time information and improve the overall aviation safety. The non-invasive nature of the sensor is essential as it does not hinder aviation functionality and maintains the integrity of the aircraft. The methodology of this sensor is based on near-field microwave sensing, where the resonator resonates at various depths of ice, which is reflected in the transmission parameters as a frequency dip. The sensor was designed using the principle of a half-ring coupled resonator with the arrangement of CCSRR. The sensor resonates at 3.583 GHz, obtaining a significant shift with varying ice thickness. Then, the sensor is fabricated and tested. From the results, this CCSRR design is low-cost, noninvasive, compact, and gives real-time information; hence, it is feasible to use on aircraft.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Model Predictive Control (MPC) For Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) Systems: A LABVIEW-Based Approach For Quadruple Tank Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study explores the application of Model Predictive Control (MPC) in multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) processes, focusing on redesigning the MPC system for a four-tank system known as Quadruple. MPC is utilized in process industries to forecast future controller outputs and minimize system costs by determining optimal future control actions. Control action rates and plant outputs are adjusted by modifying weight matrices. The specified prediction and control horizons serve as key control parameters. The redesign of the MPC system for the Quadruple system involves designing and implementing it using LABVIEW software. LABVIEW simplifies the complexity of MPC controller design and implementation. The primary objective of four-tank system is to maintain consistent fluid levels in each tank, with LABVIEW facilitating the implementation of automatic controllers for effective control in process plants.

Author Keywords: Multiple Input and Multiple output process

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Protocol Conversion Unit for SPI to I2C Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One of the most popular ways to connect microcontrollers to a variety of peripherals, including sensors, shift registers, SRAM, Analog-to-Digital converters (ADC), and Digital-to-Analog converters (DAC), is through Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI). On the other hand, the InterIntegrated Circuit (I2C) offers a two-wire bus solution that enables many system devices to communicate with one another. Synchronous serial communication, or SPI, is widely used in embedded systems, where microprocessors and microcontrollers communicate with peripherals, enabling shortrange data transmission. In the meantime, I2C which has a reputation for having a slower communication speed works best in promoting communication between integrated circuits. In order to provide smooth communication between SPI and I2C, two commonly used serial communication protocols, this work aims to construct and simulate a Protocol Conversion Unit (PCU). This kind of architecture makes it possible for the SPI protocol to work with a receiver device that uses the I2C protocol, which would not be possible otherwise. I2C only supports half-duplex communication; in contrast, SPI supports full-duplex communication and runs at a quicker speed. I2C just needs two wires since it doesn’t require a separate slave select line as SPI requires. The address and acknowledgment protocol is used in I2C instead of other protocols for communication with the slave.

articleTitle: Li- Ion Battery Life Cycle Estimation by KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Precise estimation of the life cycle of Li-Ion batteries is a critical function of the Battery Management System (BMS). Among various approaches, data-driven methods are gaining prominence for State of Health ($\mathbf{(S O H})$ estimation due to their simplicity, suitability for real-time applications, and independence from complex battery models. This study proposes a machine learning based approach using the k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm, which efficiently predicts battery life by analyzing charge-discharge sequences and their impact on battery degradation. The algorithm’s performance is evaluated using an open dataset, demonstrating its high accuracy in estimating battery SOH. Also, this research study explores the advantages and limitations of existing SOH estimation methods and highlights the potential of the proposed model for hybrid electric vehicle applications.

articleTitle: Implementation of A High Speed Layout Parallel Prefix Adder for Design Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One of the essential components of applications like signal processing, adders play a crucial role. Integrated circuits are the main technology used in the modern world, and adder modules are required. The arithmetic operationmost often used in digital systems is binary addition. Reliability depends heavily on the efficiency of its adders.If the digital adder could be made more efficient, it would handle binary operations much better. A microprocessor’s minimum clock cycle time is defined by the speed of its adder. The overall performance of the system is always determined by combining the adders power dissipation, speed, and area. Carry propagation is a performance problem with the addition operation that affects its speed. As a result, VLSI (Very Large-Scale Integration) has been continually focusing on speed increase while reducing covered area. A parallel prefix adder’s speed is the primary consideration when choosing between a ripple carry adder and our preferred alternative. For both latency and coverage area, the best adders in use right now are PPAs, or parallel prefix adders. They are hence the recommended option given the larger number of high-performance adders. An efficient layout parallel prefix adder has been developed and is now accessible to use in design applications. The area (number of LUTs), delay (ns), power, and speed of the suggested designs is better compared to RCA & CLA adders.

Author Keywords: Parallel Prefix Adder and High Speed

articleTitle: Student Placement Prediction using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Improving student placement prediction is crucial for educational institutions aiming to guide their graduates towards successful careers. Traditional methods often fall short in managing the complexity and variety of student data, highlighting the need for a more sophisticated predictive approach. This research proposes a cutting-edge deep learning-based system that integrates Feedforward Neural Networks (FNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The objective is to develop an advanced predictive model capable of efficiently analyzing diverse student data sources. By integrating FNNs, RNNs, and LSTMs, the proposed system can interpret complex student information and generate valuable insights for educational institutions. Its accuracy in predicting placement probabilities and mapping out career trajectories is tailored to students’ abilities and career goals. Consequently, this model enables institutions to create customized placement strategies, enhancing students’ opportunities for success and improving their career outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Historical Data Preservation: A Robust Steganographic Framework with Steghide Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Steganography, Steganography, an art of covert communication, conceals data within various media forms, such as images and audio, eluding detection by unsuspecting observers. Tracing back to the example above, steganography utilizes steghide, which as an open-source tool excels at hiding historical data held within images or audio recordings. In this model work of original research, the functionality of Steghide is extended with Alternate Encryption Standard (AES) and Least Significant Bit (LSB) methods to provide a better preservation for historical data while enforcing privacy and security using additional protection layers. By seamlessly blending with the encryption functionality using AES and embedded to LSB, we are able to both make our historical data stronger, and also further strengthens integrity of records against unauthorized access or tampering. This adds a layer of visibility and resiliency in information storage which meets the exacting requirements for historical data retention. The simple menu of steghide creates an easy to use way to either hide your data with in another file, whether it be small or large files upholding ethical obligations. However, during Steghide’s accomplishment of abiding incessantly to ethical and law-abiding principles, it remains the premier class-leader discreet integrated tool for a reliable historical data repository packed with genuine user confidence as well reinforcing secure archival practices.

articleTitle: Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring and Automated Disposal System for Process Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study focuses on the development of a Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring and Automated Disposal System for the textile dyeing industry. The system monitors key water quality parameters pH, temperature, and Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) using IoT enabled sensors. Based on real-time sensor data, it automatically categorizes wastewater into three types reusable water, irrigation-suitable water, and chemically contaminated water. Automated solenoid valves control the flow of water to appropriate channels based on these categories. The system also features a manual mode, allowing users to manually actuate the solenoid valves as needed. Real-time data, including water quality parameters and valve operations, is displayed on the Blynk platform, enabling remote monitoring and control. Furthermore, the project explores the reuse of chemical water in cement manufacturing. This smart solution promotes sustainable water management, reduces environmental impact, and supports resource reuse within the textile dyeing and construction industries.

articleTitle: SafeRoute: Pioneering Online Ride Booking with Pega & ML-Powered Safety Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The advent of online ride booking services has revolutionized the transportation industry, providing users with convenient and efficient means of commuting. However, ensuring the safety of passengers and drivers remains a paramount concern. This project introduces an innovative solution that leverages Pega, a leading business process management platform, coupled with machine learning algorithms to enhance the safety measures within an online ride booking service. The proposed system integrates seamlessly into the existing online ride booking infrastructure and introduces advanced safety mechanisms based on realtime data analysis. Machine learning models are employed to predict and mitigate potential risks, ensuring a secure and reliable experience for both passengers and drivers.

articleTitle: Handling Depression: An In-depth Study on its Causes and Treatment through Novel Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Depression is a prevalent mental health condition that significantly impacts individuals’ lives. This research aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the factors contributing to depression and explore innovative treatment approaches. By examining existing research and empirical data, this study delves into the complex interplay of genetic, biological, and environmental factors that contribute to the development of depression. Additionally, it explores the effectiveness of traditional and emerging treatment modalities, such as medication, psychotherapy, and novel therapies. The findings of this research will provide valuable insights into the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of depression. By understanding the underlying mechanisms and identifying effective interventions, we can work towards improving the lives of individuals affected by this debilitating condition.

articleTitle: IoT-based Posture Pro: Safeguarding the Human Spine from the Onset of Hunchback in the Initial Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The Posture Pro, a smart body posture improver, is a specialized device aiding people in maintaining good posture while sitting or standing. It distinguishes itself from standard correctors by its ability to attach to and detach from a chair, providing customized support. Poor posture can lead to various health issues, such as headaches, stomach troubles, and back/neck discomfort. The Posture Pro gently realigns the shoulders and spine, reducing muscle and joint tension, improving circulation, and minimizing injury risk. It is especially beneficial for desk-bound individuals or those with chronic back pain, aiding in posture correction, pain relief, and enhanced mobility. It is critical to combine its use with regular exercise and stretching to maintain general wellness. There are other styles to choose from, such as materials for bracing that are apparent for support or covert ones that are worn under clothes. It is essential to fit and adjust properly to avoid pain or a worsening of existing conditions. It is advised to adopt the modified posture gradually to give the body time to adjust. The Posture Pro is a flexible way to correct posture both in and out of the chair because of its detachable and chair-fixable function.

articleTitle: Enhanced Device Alert System using NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper aims to provide a practical and efficient way to deal with the enduring problem of smartphone and laptop theft. The NodeMCU Wi-Fi module is used by the system to quickly alert users when their devices are moved or disconnected without authorization. Wi-Fi transmission of unique identity information guarantees timely alerting, allowing users to take appropriate action in case of possible theft. Building on this base, a number of improvements can strengthen device security and increase user confidence. First of all, adding GPS tracking would greatly increase the efficacy of the system. In addition to making it easier to quickly retrieve stolen electronics, real-time location tracking discourages would-be burglars. Additionally, tamper detection sensors provide an extra line of protection. These sensors are capable of identifying any unauthorized efforts to alter or access the device, and they can promptly notify the user of these attempts.

articleTitle: A Water Sprinkler-based Automatic Cooling System in a Textile Company
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Textile factories can often become hot and humid due to the machinery used in the production process. This can create an uncomfortable working environment for employees, affecting their productivity and leading to reduced productivity. High temperatures can cause yarn to become less pliable, leading to breakage and waste, resulting in significant losses. In order to address the issue of high temperatures and humidity levels in textile mills, a system employing an Arduino UNO microcontroller board and a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor has been developed. The system is controlled by an Arduino UNO microcontroller board, which receives data from a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor. When the temperature surpasses the set threshold, the microcontroller activates a relay module, which then triggers the water sprinkler to cool down the environment. This automatic system ensures that the working environment remains comfortable for employees, without the need for manual intervention. By automatically activating a water sprinkler when the temperature exceeds a set threshold, the system can help maintain the pliability of the yarn, reducing the chances of breakage during the production process. The system is also cost-effective and efficient, making it an ideal investment for textile manufacturers looking to improve production efficiency, reduce material waste, and maintain a comfortable working environment for employees.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Solar Energy Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Predicting solar power generation is necessary to successfully integrate solar energy into the grid and reduce the impact of changing weather on the system. Predicting the solar power output can reduce costs and improve financial predictions for solar energy systems. It allows for better timing of maintenance, reducing downtime and improving the efficiency of solar systems. Due to its adaptable nature, Random Forest (RF) is appropriate for a range of solar energy input variables such as temperature, humidity, solar irradiance, and others, whether numerical or categorical. Artificial neural networks are successful when working with large datasets and maintain good performance as data volume increases. This study presents Artificial Neural Networks in combination with the Random Forest Algorithm. Customizing this approach can address specific challenges in predicting solar energy, like incorporating different types of input data (e.g., time-series data, weather conditions) and adjusting to varying prediction goals (e.g., short-term forecasts, long-term predictions). Combining RF and ANN techniques can potentially achieve significant improvements in solar energy prediction accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Efficient Non-Local Similarity-based Image Dehazing: A Pixel-Level Approach for Enhanced Performance and Robustness
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study proposes an efficient approach for image dehazing using non-local similarity-based methods. Dehazing has roots in many applications, including image enhancement of underwater imagery, satellite aerial images, remote sensing imagery, and many others. The proposed method considers the challenges of single-image dehazing. The method involves the identification and recognition of haze lines. After identifying haze lines, a regularization process is introduced to consider the variance of the estimated haze lines. This regularization ensures that only the pixels adhering to the model's assumptions contribute to the reconstruction process. The proposed algorithm works at the pixel level rather than at the patch or regions of patch-level techniques. This results in improved speed, robustness, and reduced sensitivity to parameters like patch size and content. Performance analysis was done using several focus measures. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The simulation results prove that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: The Development of a Machine Learning-based Diabetes Screening System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease that affects millions of people worldwide. Early detection and timely intervention are crucial for preventing severe complications. Traditional diagnostic methods can be time-consuming and invasive. This research explores the application of machine learning techniques to develop a non-invasive and efficient diabetes screening system. By analyzing various patient data, including demographic, clinical, and lifestyle factors, the model aims to accurately predict the likelihood of developing diabetes. The study compares the performance of different classification algorithms, such as Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression, in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and AUC-ROC. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of Gradient Boosting in accurately identifying individuals at risk of diabetes. This research has the potential to significantly improve early diabetes detection and contribute to better disease management and prevention.

articleTitle: 6G Enabled Healthcare -A Survey on Future of Intelligent Care System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The healthcare sector is undergoing a significant transformation due to emerging disruptive communication technologies. Advanced technologies such as augmented reality, virtual reality, robotic applications are enabling real-time remote surgeries. The advent of 6G system, which supports these advanced intelligent technologies promises to advance healthcare for individuals of all ages within a 3 dimensional space. Existing literature lacks a comprehensive discussion on the application of these disruptive technologies within the context of 6G intelligent healthcare. This research study provides a framework for 6G intelligent healthcare and discuss various disruptive technologies and challenges. Key technologies like digital twins, quantum communication, and artificial intelligence, etc. are examined for its potential challenges in modern healthcare. While 5G technology falls short in supporting intelligence, disruptive technologies required for advanced healthcare, 6G is expected to provide highly reliable, secure and ultra-high speed communication. Additionally, 6G will facilitate the IoE and every Internet based techniques, thereby optimizing global healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Assistive Robotic Arm for Wheelchairs: Enhancing Daily Living for the Disabled
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Robots have now become necessary components in today’s differentiated globalized society because of their efficiency as well as the effectiveness of services in diverse sectors. The objective of this work is to design a robotic arm which can be easily attached on a wheelchair that can be used by disabled or paralyzed people. In spite of increasing the ability to carry out few tasks independently beyond the constraints of their disability, the robotic arm helps the disabled to better interact with the environment. The arm also makes possible things that many of the abled people do effortlessly for instance, opening doors, or controlling appliances at home. Overall it improves the quality of life of the disabled. The arm can perform certain predefined tasks or it can even be controlled through a mobile app. Commands corresponding to different actions or movements are received by the Arduino through the Bluetooth connection established between the smartphone and Arduino. The operation of the arm will be concise and intuitive. The proposed arm is a step closer to the creation of a society where technology aids the less fortunate with a way to the independent life they desire. The work proposed strive to create a change in the lives of disabled community to achieve improved mobility and option in the future.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Monkeypox Disease based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Monkeypox virus is widely spreading across the world at a rapid rate, after the aftermath of COVID-19 disease. It is spread via body contact, droplets, or mucusof the eye, nose, or mouth. Some of the early-stage symptoms of patients are fever, aches in body or fatigue or red bump on the skin. Monkeypox is a disease from the genus Orthopoxvirus. It closely resembles chickenpox, smallpox and measles regarding clinical features. The minor variations in rashes on the skin, coupled with the relative rareness of monkeypox have made the diagnosis of this condition at early stage challenging for healthcare professionals. The symptoms will last for 2 to 4 weeks. In this paper, Monkeypox Skin Image Dataset is used to study the efficiency using Convolution Neural Network classification models on the images of skin for Monkeypox detection among smallpox, chickenpox and measles. This study found that ResNet-50 model has great potential in the detection of Monkeypox disease.

articleTitle: Novel Gender and Age Prediction from Real Time Facial Images using Linear Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The proposed novel algorithm utilizes linear regression in real-time facial image analysis for predicting both gender and age. By leveraging features extracted from facial data, the model aims to provide accurate and instantaneous predictions. The emergence of social media platforms has made the automatic classification of gender and age increasingly relevant. Real-time frame processing is possible with OpenCV. The expected gender and age are provided as the output, and this frame is provided as the input. The capacity to autonomously ascertain age and gender from facial images because of its versatility in facial analysis applications. However, the current models are still behind the required accuracy level, which is required for these models to be used in real-world applications, because of the significant intraclass variance of face images (such as difference in lighting, position, scale, and occlusion). In this work, a deep learning framework uses an ensemble of residual and attentional convolutional networks to reliably determine the gender and age group of facial photographs. By employing an attention mechanism, this model can concentrate on the important and instructive aspects of the face, increasing its prediction accuracy to 90.15%.

articleTitle: Formal Verification of Clock Synchronization Algorithms for Aerospace Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In man-rated missions of launch vehicles, quadruple redundancy is generally provided for the different subsystems. In this work, the extension of the master-slave algorithm and a convergence averaging scheme for clock synchronization were studied and validated through formal methods. The results proved that the specified properties are satisfied in both the schemes. The averaging scheme has the advantage of simplicity and consequently executes with lesser resources. The main contribution is the definition of a methodical process for modelling and verification of embedded software in the Ada language using two varied approaches. The application of the techniques to a real case study proved its efficacy in establishing the correctness of the software in critical systems.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning with Fuzzy Neural Network for Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Many researchers are currently having difficulty predicting diseases due to the vast number of medical records. Researchers are using data mining techniques like association rules, classification, and clustering to get around these challenges. With the use of prediction, doctors can diagnose a variety of diseases with accuracy. Although the current study classifies the data to forecast specific diseases, overfitting in the training data continues to provide challenges. Recursive Feature Elimination is used to remove unnecessary features from Medical Data. The features are then ranked to lower the computational cost of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Power Management Comparison in DC -DC Converters For Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) power management systems include DC-DC converters, which are typically difficult to design. SEPIC Converters are More complex design and more components are required than buck or boost converters. Less efficient than basic buck or boost designs. Flyback Converter has Higher voltage stress on components. Lower efficiency than non-isolated converters. This paper compares and studies various bidirectional DC-DC converter topologies. Two topologies under consideration are half-bridge (HB) converters and buck boost (BB) converters. comparison study is accomplished through graphs, with the relevant variables being plotted against the output voltage and output power. wide output voltage requirements, which are common for applications for power management. BB Converters More complex control circuit compared to buck or boost converters. Typically less efficient than a pure buck or boost converter. HB Converters are Appropriate for largescale battery management in systems like solar power inverters or electric vehicle (EV) battery systems. Half-bridge converters are frequently the preferred option for a wide variety of electric vehicle applications because they typically offer superior performance.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation and Classification using Deep neural networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Accurate segmentation and recognition of brain tumors are vital in medical research for correct diagnosis and strategic treatment planning. This project proposes an innovative approach by combining segmentation and classification to expand the accuracy and efficacy of brain tumor evaluation. At first, a UNet model is implemented to demarcate the brain tumors in 2D MRI images. This phase involves isolating the tumor from the background, resulting in segmented images. Subsequently, the original MRI images are concatenated with the segmented images to create enhanced inputs. Following the segmentation, a CNN model is developed to classify brain tumor types. The concatenated images are inputted into the CNN model for classification, enabling the network to learn from both the original MRI images and their segmented versions. Validations are carried out on a dataset comprising 2D MRI slices of brain tumors, including glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumor types. The proposed approach yielded favorable outcomes in both segmentation and classification accuracy. The segmentation phase attained a Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 76% for tumor regions, while the classification model achieved an accuracy of 92% on the test dataset.

articleTitle: Smart Air-Conditioner Monitoring by IOT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The main issue faced at these times is that the consumers have to manually remove and change the internal components manually in an air conditioner such as a rotor or compressor because of overheat that may result in the particular air conditioner malfunctioning. An air conditioner is made up of many components, but the major parts doing the heavy lifting of moving the air indoors and outdoors are the evaporator, condenser, expansion valve, and compressor. Advanced air conditioner air filtration systems are considered to be the latest innovation in air condition technology which help to improve indoor air quality and reduce allergens, as well as help with cooling efficiency. In this project, when one of the components of an air conditioner is overheated, a coolant system acquires the temperature as input and begins functioning when the temperature of the component exceeds the limit set in the Arduino code. This system helps in reducing the temperature of the component in the air conditioner and guarantees operation for a prolonged period of time. Also, the moisture content because of the refrigerant gas present inside the air conditioner is recorded using a humidity sensor. Both temperature and humidity readings are notified to the administrator with the help of a GSM module. The coolant system for reducing the temperature of the component could be even an exhaust fan used in the central processing unit of a computer.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Disease Detection in Sweet Lemon Leaves to Enhance Citrus Fruit Yield
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The application of deep learning(DL approaches to the problem of identifying diseases of the sweet lemon leaf is a recent promising outcomes in many artificial intelligence (A) problems. Numerous techniques are used in machine learning (ML) models for classification and detection; however, given the ongoing progress in computer vision, it seems that deep learning (DL) research has a lot of promise for improving accuracy. The presence of diseases affecting sweet lemon leaves has a significant influence on Rayalaseema's economy, leading to lower-quality fruit production and a higher incidence of canker, greening, black spot, and other diseases. There is a shortage of research datasets and a restricted variety of pests, making it challenging to adapt research findings to agriculture in the area of sweet lemon leaf pest disease. The recommended strategy is assessed on the combined sweet lemon leaf disease picture datasets in the proposed study, which offers a method for identifying and categorizing diseases in sweet lemon leaf disease plants using deep learning and image processing. CNN, ResNet, MobileNet, and VGG16 are the models used to identify sweet lemon leaf disease. With an accuracy rate of $98.6 \%$, the suggested MobileNetV2 model outperforms the current CNN technique.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Prediction on Future Aspect using XGBoost Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study investigates the potentiality of wind energy in Romania. The wind energy profile for the last 5.5 years has been considered for the statistical analysis by which future aspect can be rendered. The time series model Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) has been taken as a machine learning tool for the analysis of wind energy production. From the data scheme, it is observed that maximum wind energy production is 2811 MW whereas the maximum total production is $\mathbf{9 8 8 6} \mathbf{M W}$. It is easily can be realized that the wind energy production in the future aspect is very important as the share of wind energy plays a vital role in mitigation of the energy crisis. This paper has given a portfolio for the future aspect of wind potentiality using XGBoost model analysis. The minimum RMSE by this prediction model has been recorded as 325.23 for the validation dataset which is prompting the better data prediction analysis.

articleTitle: Video Stabilization using SURF-CNN for Surveillance Application
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Stabilizing videos is an essential initial stage for many computer vision tasks. Although traditional approaches have demonstrated potential outcomes, they frequently encounter difficulties when dealing with complex movements and loud surroundings. This article introduces an innovative method for video stabilization that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with the SURF algorithm. SURF is utilized for deriving strong characteristic points from the video frames, whereas the CNN is capable of estimating the best transformation parameters for steadying the video series. Our suggested approach surpasses current cutting-edge techniques in video stabilization quality, computational efficiency, and noise resistance, as shown by experimental results on difficult video datasets. We assess our method’s performance by utilizing quantitative metrics like mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and inter-frame transformation fidelity (IFT) of $\mathbf{6 8. 7 3} \mathrm{fps}$ over existing methods

articleTitle: Fabric Defect Detection System for Textile Webmaterial using YOLOv8 on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The textile industry relies heavily on quality control to ensure product consistency and customer satisfaction. Traditional manual inspection methods are timeconsuming, prone to human error, and often lack consistency. To address these challenges, this research proposes an automated fabric defect detection system using the YOLOv8-m model. The proposed system utilizes a camera interfaced with a Raspberry Pi to capture high-resolution images of woven fabrics. The YOLOv8-m model is employed to accurately identify and classify defects such as holes and cuts. The model achieves impressive performance metrics, including an accuracy of 95%, precision of 94%, and recall of 93%, with an average processing time of 0.2 seconds per image. By automating the defect detection process, this system offers several benefits, including improved efficiency, reduced labor costs, and enhanced product quality. It can be easily integrated into textile manufacturing processes, enabling real-time monitoring and quality control. This research contributes to the advancement of automated quality control systems in the textile industry.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Ovarian cancer utilizing SVMs and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Accurate and timely cancer diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment and patient survival. This research investigates the application of machine learning algorithms, specifically Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), to improve cancer diagnosis. The study utilizes a dataset containing both malignant and benign tumor samples to train and evaluate the proposed models. The performance of the models is assessed using metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and AUC. The results demonstrate that SVM outperforms ANN in classifying cancer types, achieving a higher accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 0 8 \%}$ compared to $\mathbf{8 9 \%}$ for ANN. This research highlights the potential of machine learning in enhancing cancer diagnosis and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Skin Disease Diagnosis: Advanced Image Analysis and Precision Healthcare using EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Skin disease classification is a critical aspect of dermatological diagnostics, with millions of people globally affected by diverse conditions. Skin diseases, ranging from infectious to neoplastic, are traditionally classified manually, a process prone to time-consuming errors. Deep learning, notably Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), offers an effective solution by automatically learning hierarchical features from image data. The chosen EfficientNet architecture strikes a balance between model size and performance, making it ideal for resource-constrained environments such as healthcare settings. Manual classification of skin diseases, a traditionally time-consuming process prone to errors, necessitates a more efficient solution. Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), notably the EfficientNetB4 architecture, We got a phenomenal training accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9 \%}$ and a robust testing accuracy of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$. This signifies the efficacy of deep learning in automating the identification and classification of diverse skin conditions.

articleTitle: Smart Health Monitoring for Comatose Patients: Integrating IoT and Real-Time Alerts
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study develops a specialized monitoring and warning system tailored for coma patients to ensure timely and accurate assessment of their health status. The system integrates various physiological markers, including temperature, heart rate, urine level, finger movement, and blink frequency, using non-invasive sensors. Alongside critical indicators, it continuously monitors these parameters to enable rapid caregiver and medical specialist responses to significant changes in the patient’s condition. Additionally, the system incorporates email and phone notifications for immediate alerts. A computer vision-based eye blink monitoring module tracks and evaluates neurological activity through blink frequency analysis. Furthermore, a real-time urine level monitoring system employs sensors to gather and transmit data, facilitating early detection of potential health issues. Future work includes leveraging AI and machine learning for predictive analytics and enhancing interoperability with other medical devices for comprehensive healthcare management.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Underwater Communication Using Bio-Inspired Algorithms in Metaheuristic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The condition of the ocean is monitored through a network of acoustic sensor nodes. After the transmitter and receiver nodes are formed, they are placed in a shallow sea environment. Underwater communication takes more time, so optimization of it is a top priority. Cat swarm optimization method and sea lion optimization algorithms are two examples of currently used bio-inspired algorithms. By analyzing the output parameters of both algorithms, we can see which one is more optimized. When comparing cat swarm optimization techniques to, the sea lion algorithm provides superior energy efficiency by lowering the amount of power required to process acoustic sensor node data. articleTitle: Cobb Angle Measurement using U-Net for Scoliosis Treatment Plans
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Scoliosis, a condition characterized by abnormal spinal curvature, remains a critical challenge in paediatric healthcare, especially in the accurate measurement of the Cobb angle, which is essential for assessing its severity. This study presents ATT UNet 3+, a deep learning model designed for automatic Cobb angle measurement, improving upon existing models with its hybrid attention mechanism. By training and validating on 155 X-ray images, ATT UNet 3+ demonstrated superior performance in segmentation accuracy compared to traditional methods. With an error margin of just 1.6°, it offers a reliable tool for efficient scoliosis diagnosis and treatment planning, reducing dependence on manual evaluation. This research highlights the potential of deep learning in enhancing medical imaging techniques, facilitating faster and more accurate assessments in clinical environments.

articleTitle: Paddy Plant Disease Detection using Hybrid Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Agriculture is the backbone of India’s economy, supporting a large portion of the population and establishing the country as a key global player in food production. India ranks as the second-largest producer of both paddy and wheat. However, agricultural productivity is highly susceptible to various plant diseases, which can significantly reduce crop yields and quality. Paddy, one of the most important staple crops, is particularly vulnerable to diseases caused mainly by viral and bacterial related diseases. The climate conditions are also play a vital role in paddy plant diseases. This research work proposes a deep learning-based approach for early detection and classification of paddy diseases. The proposed research devises a hybrid model that combines the VGG19 and ResNet50 algorithms, the system analyses images of both healthy and disease-affected paddy leaves, sourced from the Kaggle repository. This research focuses on predicting four major paddy diseases that can cause yield losses of up to 80%, and in severe cases, can destroy an entire crop: (i) Paddy Blast, (ii) Bacterial Leaf Blight, (iii) Sheath Blight, and (iv) Ufra Disease. The proposed model achieves a high accuracy rate of 98% in predicting paddy diseases and offers a rapid classification process, showcasing the potential of advanced image processing and deep learning techniques to mitigate the impact of paddy plant diseases on agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Classification of Brain Tumor based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The identification of brain tumors is an important task in medical imaging. Manual classification of brain tumors can lead to inaccurate diagnoses due to various restricting factors. Brain tumors can be difficult to extract from images because they have diverse appearances and can look similar to normal tissue. This research study proposes a new way to identify brain tumors with brain pictures using convolutional neural network. The proposed method is tested on a dataset containing different tumor sizes, tumor shapes, tumor locations, and tumor image intensities. Simulation results shows that proposed classifier successfully identifies different types of tumors i.e. implemented a CNN with Keras and Tensorflow, which outperformed the traditional classifier with an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 8 7 \%}$.

articleTitle: PlantPulse: Intelligent CNN-based Analysis for Effective Maize Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Management of crop health and guarantes of food security depend on accurate detection of maize leaf diseases. highly laborious and prone to errors are conventional manual inspection techniques. This work uses a convolutional neural network can automatically increase disease detection precision for maize leaves. With images scaled to $256 \times 256$ pixels and enhanced through rotation and scaling to boost generalization, the CNN model was Instruction utilising a photo dataset. classified into four categories: Common rust; blight; grey leaf spot; healthy leaves. Built with convolutional, dropout, pooling, fully connected layers, trained with a batch size of 32 using categorical cross-entropy loss and Adam optimiser spanning 15 epochs. With an overall accuracy of 89%, evaluation guidelines comprising recall, precision and F1-score point to excellent performance. While Blight (precision: 0.84, recall: 0.87) and Grey Leaf Spot (precision: 0.73, recall: 0.71) exhibit somewhat less performance, the model shines in spotting Healthy leaves (precision: 1.00, recall: 0.99) and Common Rust (precision: 1.00, recall: 0.99). With reliable disease diagnosis to promote crop management and enhance food security, the CNN model has great practical relevance in agriculture.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a High-Frequency PLL with a 20.70 GHz VCO and Low-Phase Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The evaluation of the performance of a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) proposed to produce a Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO) frequency of 20.70 GHz is presented in this paper. Phase noise measurements at a 1 MHz offset from the carrier frequency show a final phase noise of ${- 1 05.50} \mathrm{~ d B c} / \mathrm{H z}$. The system’s Figure of Merit (FOM), which shows how well the PLL performs in terms of phase noise to power consumption, is $-38.38 \mathrm{dBc} / \mathrm{Hz}$ at an offset of 100 kHz and $-108.51 \mathrm{dBc} / \mathrm{Hz}$ at an offset of 1 MHz. The results presented emphasize the PLL’s applicability for high-frequency applications where low-phase noise and high-frequency.

articleTitle: Manhole Detection and System Monitoring Controlled by IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The IoT-based Manhole Monitoring System is a solution that aims to improve city drainage system management by effectively addressing the challenges that today’s drainage networks face. Using a network of sensors and GSM modules, this system not only detects and notifies authorities of potential hazards such as gas leaks and sewage overflows, but also provides them with real-time data to help them make informed decisions. Its strategic placement of sensors, which includes water flow rate sensors, temperature sensors, and tilt sensors, ensures precise monitoring of critical parameters, allowing for proactive measures to prevent blockages and system malfunctions. Furthermore, the seamless integration with Thing Speak enables secure data storage, thorough analysis, and insightful visualization, allowing the government to gain comprehensive insights into system performance and emerging trends over time The system’s ability to send SMS notifications ensures smooth communication and timely responses in emergency situations, encouraging a collaborative approach to urban infrastructure management. In the face of global urbanization and environmental challenges, the IoT-based Manhole Monitoring System emerges as a new sewage system that prioritizes resilience, efficiency, and sustainability in urban development. Its implementation represents a significant advancement in safeguarding.

articleTitle: Auto Track: A Web Platform to Manage Servicing, Predict Resell Price and Optimize Vehicle Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Auto-Track: Revolutionizes Vehicle Management through Data-Driven Insights is an innovative web application built on the MERN stack, designed to modernize vehicle ownership by offering a streamlined platform for essential tasks such as scheduling appointments with top-rated garages, based on user ratings and reviews. It also features secure document storage for vehicle registration and insurance. Auto Track automatically tracks service history, offering detailed information like service dates, garage locations, parts replaced, costs, and visual documentation, enabling users to make informed decisions. The core feature is a machine learning model that analyses a vehicle’s service history to predict resale value, empowering users to make better pricing decisions or plan future maintenance investments. Additional functionalities, such as timely service reminders and on-demand roadside assistance, improve the user experience by promoting preventive maintenance and ensuring rapid assistance in emergencies. The present work discusses the development and functionality of Auto Track, focusing on its potential to enhance vehicle management and build trust through data-driven insights. Future enhancements may include optimizing the machine learning model, integrating fuel efficiency tracking based on driving behavior, and connecting with other automotive services to offer a new vehicle management ecosystem, positioning Auto Track as a transformative tool in vehicle ownership.

articleTitle: Bridging Safety and Technology: Deep Learning Innovations in Automated Tire Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Acting as the main point of contact with the road, tires are fundamental for vehicle safety, performance, and fuel economy. Tread wear, cracks, bulges, and punctures—defects that over time could cause accidents if left unnoticed—develop in tires. Early discovery of these flaws not only increases safety but also, by enabling prompt repairs, lowers maintenance costs. This work investigates the use of a deep learning-based image classification system, Inspection V3 model, to automatically evaluate tire quality. Processing a dataset of 1,856 photos comprising 830 excellent tires and 1,328 bad tires, the model employs convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to precisely detect tire states. To maximize the pre-trained model, data augmentation methods and fine-tuning of it were used. Over 100 epochs, a batch size of 16 helped the model to be trained with a test accuracy of 96%. This great degree of accuracy shows that the model can precisely detect tire flaws, so it is a useful instrument for automated tire inspections. Particularly for companies running sizable fleets of vehicles, the deployment of such systems can improve road safety, minimize vehicle downtime, and lower running costs.

articleTitle: A Flutter App for AI-Based Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A brand-new plant care detection system that combines a Flutter application and a convolutional neural network (CNN) model is being introduced, offering plant care enthusiasts an advanced but approachable solution. A thorough plant care experience is provided by this cutting-edge solution, which utilizes Python and AI.
