Based on the condition of the plant, the CNN model has been trained to evaluate photos of plants and make care recommendation. The interface is the Flutter application, which makes it simple for users to take and submit pictures of their plants for examination. In addition to offering care advice, appropriate plant types are identified by the system’s AI algorithms based on user preferences and environmental factors. Real-time plant health monitoring is also allowed for by the technology, alerting users to any problems that need to be addressed. Our tests show that a smooth and efficient way to take care of plants is provided by this integrated system, enabling users to easily maintain happy, healthy plants. A state-of-the-art plant care detection system is proposed by this research, combining a Flutter application with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, offering a reliable and easy-to-use solution for plant aficionados. A thorough plant care experience is provided by the system by utilizing AI and Python. Plant image analysis and conditionbased care suggestions have been used to train the CNN model. The interface is the Flutter application, which makes it simple for users to take and submit pictures of their plants for examination. In addition to offering maintenance guidance, appropriate plant species are recommended by the AI algorithms based on user preferences and environmental parameters. Additionally, real-time plant health monitoring is allowed for by the technology and users are alerted to any problems that require care.

articleTitle: SVM-Driven Approach for Source Camera Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study presents a Support Vector Machine (SVM)-driven approach for source camera identification, focusing on extracting Sensor Pattern Noise (SPN) as a distinctive feature. The study investigates the effectiveness of SVM in accurately identifying the source camera by leveraging SPN and other intrinsic image characteristics. Comparative analysis with advanced models, including Random Forests, Gradient Boosting Machines, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), highlights the strengths and limitations of SVM. While CNNs demonstrate higher accuracy, SVM provides an efficient balance between accuracy and computational resources. The proposed SVM model is evaluated on publicly available datasets and achieves robust performance, demonstrating its relevance for forensic applications, security, and image authenticity verification. Further improvements are discussed, including strategies for enhancing model accuracy and handling complex classification scenarios.

articleTitle: Stoic Wisdom Meets Modern AI: Leveraging Large Language Models for Philosophical Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study introduces a novel platform that merges the ancient wisdom of Stoicism with contemporary artificial intelligence to offer personalized philosophical guidance. By harnessing the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and employing Prompt Engineering techniques, the platform generates customized Stoic advice in response to user inquiries. Utilizing the advanced Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) architecture, the system delivers contextually relevant insights and actionable steps, making Stoic principles more accessible and practical for modern users. This fusion of cutting-edge technology and timeless wisdom provides a unique resource for individuals seeking to apply Stoic teachings in their daily lives, thereby addressing the challenges of personalizing and implementing philosophical concepts in a contemporary context.

articleTitle: Design of a Recommendation System for an Efficient and Optimized (RSU) Usage and Protect from External Influences
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In recent years, recommendation systems have become prevalent in various domains, such as multimedia streaming, e-commerce and social media, enhancing user experience through personalized content delivery. However, these systems are vulnerable to external influences that can distort recommendations and lead to biased results. This paper presents a novel recommendation system that optimizes the usage of Resource Sharing Units (RSUs) while protecting against external manipulation. The proposed model benefits both content providers and users by delivering accurate, preference-aligned recommendations without succumbing to external bias, thanks to advanced filtering mechanisms that detect and block potential interference. Furthermore, the system is optimized for efficient memory utilization, reducing computational load and enhancing performance. Extensive testing demonstrates its ability to resist external manipulation while maintaining optimal RSU usage offering a robust solution for personalized content delivery in manipulation-prone environments.

articleTitle: Analysis and Estimation of Time and Sensitivity in Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR)
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In most of the industrial applications exothermic chemical reactor is used that is modeled using CSTR. It is important for understanding the process of steady and unstable states. To know the serious issues of thermal runaway as it increases the temperature of exothermic reaction. For any exothermic reaction to be maintained in efficient operation it must always be kept away from thermal runaway. This project goal is to do mathematical modelling for CSTR runaway time and to estimate the serious issues related to runaway.

articleTitle: Autonomous Farming Robot for Precision Seed Sowing and Targeted Irrigation Using Wireless Control
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: More than a significant portion of the global population opts for agriculture as their primary occupation. The primary goal of the project is to develop a versatile agricultural vehicle capable of autonomous operation. This innovation aims to reduce the labour burden on farmers while enhancing the efficiency and precision of agricultural tasks. This paper presents the design and development of an autonomous seed dispensing robot capable of performing multiple functions required in the seed planting process. The robot is designed to automate the critical stages of seed planting, including the creation of planting holes, seed dispensing, and initial watering. By employing wireless control mechanisms, the robot ensures precise operation and can be easily managed remotely. The system aims to address challenges faced in traditional farming methods, such as labour-intensive processes and inconsistent planting patterns, by providing a reliable and scalable solution. Key components include a robust mobility system for navigation, a precise drilling mechanism for hole creation, a controlled seed dispensing system for accurate seed placement, and an efficient watering system for optimal initial hydration. The results demonstrate the robot’s effectiveness in achieving uniform seed placement, consistent hole drilling, and targeted watering, all crucial for crop establishment and yield maximization. This study highlights the potential of integrating automation in agriculture to foster sustainable farming practices and improve overall agricultural productivity. The findings underscore the importance of such technologies in achieving more efficient, consistent, and scalable farming operations.

articleTitle: An Analysis of IoT based Smart Garbage Level of Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One of the largest problems the world is currently facing is waste management. Most often, it is seen that the trash is securely in place and exposed over the lockers. This spreads some deadly conditions throughout the terrain around. People also believe it is delicate to walk beside with. The main cause of all these problems is the lack of cooperation and communication among the junk platoon members. The study also demonstrated that the efficacy of the garbage operation may be significantly increased by separating the scrap at the source and discarding it separately in jilting grounds. Therefore, having a good waste management system is essential. Once these intelligent bins are widely used to replace our existing conventional dumpsters, waste can be managed effectively because it won’t needlessly pile up along the roadside. The terrible of these decomposing wastes that are left undressed for an extended period of time due to public and official indifference may cause long-term problems. A troublesome atmosphere that fosters an unhealthy environment can be produced by insect and mosquito reproduction. This might result in a dire circumstance. The information provided by the system can be used to further design the best courses of action for reducing waste mismanagement and upholding a cleaner environment.

articleTitle: FPGA-based OFDM Systems for 5G and High-Speed Communication: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a critical modulation technique for high-speed communication systems, particularly in the context of 5G networks. Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) offer significant advantages for implementing OFDM systems due to their flexibility, parallel processing capabilities, and efficiency. This review paper synthesizes recent advancements in FPGA-based OFDM implementations, focusing on various design approaches, performance metrics, and practical considerations. The review encompasses the different aspects of FPGA implementations of OFDM systems for high speed communications. It also explores FFT acceleration techniques, low-power designs, and phase compensation strategies. By analyzing the state-of-the-art techniques and their applications, this paper aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of how FPGA technology is enhancing OFDM systems for modern communication standards and future innovations

articleTitle: Advancing Tomato Crop Health: A CNN Approach to Leaf Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: One of the most grown crops worldwide, tomato plants are quite vulnerable to many leaf diseases that could seriously lower quality and productivity. Effective control and reduction of the use of chemical pesticides depend on early identification of these illnesses. The implementation of a CNN model for identifying several tomato leaf diseases is investigated in this research article. The accuracy of 95% is attained with 994 images dataset split into 10 different classes. By the help of Transfer learning, the CNN model became optimized that enabled improved performance even for a limited dataset. Confirming the model’s great accuracy, recall, and F1-scores across all classes was the confusion matrix. This work emphasizes CNNs’ promise as a consistent tool for early and accurate tomato leaf disease diagnosis, hence improving crop management and environmentally friendly farming methods.

articleTitle: Leveraging EfficientNetB3 for Automated Plant Stress Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Automated plant stress diagnosis using EfficientNetB3 architecture eliminates agricultural constraints of conventional manual inspection methods. This paper demonstrates that EfficientNetB3 can identify many stress situations including insect infestations, nutrition deficits, and drought. The model obtained an incredible 98.2% accuracy using a diverse collection of plant images using transfer learning. The results show the potential of the model to change plant health monitoring by offering a scalable and exact solution appropriate for real-time and limited resources settings. The remarkable accuracy achieved by EfficientNetB3 indicates its efficiency in early stress detection, hence reducing crop losses. Future research will focus on merging multimodal data and undertaking field-based testing to improve robustness and applicability, so promoting more sustainable and resilient farming practices.

articleTitle: Ocular Disease Detection using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The prevention of visual impairment or blindness is largely dependent on early detection of ocular illnesses, which pose a serious worldwide health burden. Using a carefully selected dataset from Kaggle, this study investigates the use of machine learning techniques for the automated detection of ocular disorders. The dataset is made up of a wide range of retinal images that have been labeled with details on different eye disorders. The goal is to find a deep learning model that is reliable and precise enough to analyze retinal images and categorize them into several disease categories, such as glaucoma, macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and normal conditions. A comparative analysis between different deep learning models like CNN, BCNN, VGG16 and VGG19 is performed in order to find the model that results in higher efficiency, that is, the model that best fits the dataset for multiocular disease detection. The idea of multi-disease detection was also proposed in the year 2021, which set a benchmark by gathering huge amount of relevant data for the study. It differentiated itself from the previous findings that where focused on predicting single ocular disease. Hence this research is a advancement in multi-disease detection where VGG16 proved to be the best fitting model for each label, with efficiency of $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: A Novel Method For Traffic Sign Detection Using Advanced Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The accurate detection of traffic signs is vital for the development of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving technologies. This paper focuses on traffic sign detection utilizing advanced image processing techniques. Our approach combines several state-of-the-art image processing methods, including Preprocessing, color segmentation, shape analysis, and feature extraction, to robustly identify and classify traffic signs in various environments. The proposed system is implemented using powerful image processing libraries such as OpenCV and scikit-image. Extensive experiments conducted on a comprehensive traffic sign dataset demonstrate the high accuracy and reliability of our method, even under challenging conditions such as partial occlusions, varying illumination, and diverse weather scenarios. The results reveal that our image processing-based approach significantly improves detection performance, providing a robust and efficient solution for real-time traffic sign recognition. This research contributes to enhancing road safety and advancing the capabilities of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: TSPC STC-DET Flip-Flop With Autogated Clock Gating For Low-Power
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: For low-power, high-performance circuits, dual edge triggered (DET) synchronized operation is highly attractive. When paired with half the clock frequency, DET operation can achieve the same throughput as traditional single-edge synchronous systems. On the clock network, which frequently contributes significantly to the total power usage of the system, this may result in significant power savings. However, specific registers that sample information on both clock edges must be created to be able to accomplish DET FF operation. Compared to their single-edge equivalents, these registers are more complicated and frequently have some clock overlay between the internal inverted clock and the main clock. This study introduces a revolutionary static DET flip flop (DET FF) that does not require a clock edge that is inverted for functionality, thus totally avoiding clock overlap concerns with a true single phased clock (TSPC). The suggested concept employs a single transistor-clocked (STC) buffer along with auto-gated clock gating technique to overcome redundant transition power with less dynamic power consumption than the current a few state-of-the-art designs. Cadence Virtuoso Design suite with 45nm CMOS technology is used to simulate the design. The suggested design outperforms the current designs with respect to power (14%), and power-delay-product, or PDP (11%) for a 10% switching activity.

articleTitle: Effective Classification and Identification of Brain Tumors using Hybrid Model of ResNet and DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A tumor in the brain is an urgent deadly condition brought on by unnatural and unregulated cell division. These tumors differ immensely in terms of their locations, textures, and sizes. (MRI) is a vital tool in finding for tumors that are cancerous. Yet, recognizing brain tumors by manual can be challenging and takes a lot of time that could result in errors. The proposed approaches utilize deep convolutional neural networks to extract Sequential data that comes from several frames and features gathered through axial slices are subsequently supplied to a neural network for classification. To address this, an enhanced brain tumor detection system uses the ResNet and DenseNet models for the precise identification of meningioma, tumors and pituitary gland cancers. To enhance the accuracy and efficacy of tumor detection, the present research introduces a novel hybrid model which incorporates the best attributes of the ResNet and DenseNet architectures. The proposed strategy makes use of DenseNet’s dense connections for optimal information flow and ResNet’s residual connections to lessen the vanishing gradient issue. The hybrid model captures detailed patterns and features in brain images through the combination of these complementing elements. The obtained outcomes indicate how successful the two suggested models are in letting the transfer learning model achieve ResNet accuracy of 93.15% and DenseNet accuracy of $\mathbf{9 1. 2 4 \%}$.

articleTitle: EcoLux: Revolutionizing Living Spaces with Smart Window Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study presents a novel automated window shade control system developed using the ESP32 microcontroller. The system integrates a Light Dependent Resistor (LDR) sensor for measuring ambient light intensity with the ESP32’s Real-Time Clock (RTC) module to achieve precise day/night detection. By combining LDR measurements with RTC data, the system effectively determines daytime and nighttime conditions, accommodating variations in natural light due to seasonal changes. This dual-parameter approach enhances the system’s accuracy in regulating shade positions. Furthermore, the system includes timebased scheduling functionality, allowing users to program shade adjustments independently of real-time light conditions. This capability is facilitated by the ESP32’s computational power, thereby increasing operational efficiency and user convenience.

articleTitle: A Cohesive Battery Management System and Charger Design for Prolonged Battery Life in Electrical Cars
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Improvements in battery technology and mounting environmental concerns are driving the growing trend of electric vehicles, or EVs. Mainstream adoption, however, depends on ensuring batteries are safe and operate at their best. The work is done with Battery Management Systems (BMS) and chargers by optimizing them. For the purpose of ensuring the battery pack operates safely and effectively, the suggested BMS continuously monitors and controls it. This design includes features critical to the health of batteries, such as temperature and voltage monitoring of the cells, cell balancing, state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health ($\mathbf{(S O H}$) assessment, current measurement, and modern amenities like variable control approaches, integrated charging algorithms, and reversible charging. The primary emphasis is on control algorithms and tactics intended to extend battery life, avoid overcharging and over-discharging, and maintain optimal thermal control. MATLAB simulations are used to verify these algorithms’ and tactics’ efficacy and are implemented them in hardware.

Author Keywords: State of Charge (SOC) and State of Health (SOH) Estimation

articleTitle: AI-driven Text Generation for News Articles using a Deep Learning BiLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study presents the development of advanced text generation using Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems. This is designed to predict, generate, and enhance the capability to produce human-like paragraphs in the domain of news articles as a paragraph for the given text. Use of a comprehensive dataset of news articles, this system implementation uses Python. Incorporation of essential libraries such as Pickle for object serialization, Numpy, and Pandas for data manipulation, and Tokenize for text preprocessing. The core of this model is built using TensorFlow-Keras, a powerful deep-learning framework that supports efficient training and deployment of neural networks. This approach ensures the handling of large datasets and facilitates the creation of an effective and scalable text generation model.

articleTitle: Development of Airborne Particle Filtering System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Design and development of an innovative air-borne particle filtering system integrated with Internet of Things (IOT) technology. The proposed system is an automated device that filters dust particles from the atmosphere using an embedded system approach. It comprises two main components: the filtering unit and the embedded control system with IOT connectivity. The embedded control system incorporates a Arduino uno, which regulates the speed of the DC motors based on real-time air quality data obtained from a dust sensor. The system leverages IOT technology to enable remote monitoring and control of the air quality. The microcontroller interfaces with an IOT module or a Wi-Fi/Ethernet interface, allowing data logging, monitoring, and remote control through a cloud-based platform or local network. Real- time air quality data, including dust particle concentrations, can be accessed and monitored remotely, enabling facility managers and environmental health and safety personnel to track air quality conditions effectively. By implementing this air-borne particle filtering system with IOT integration, textile facilities can proactively address the issue of dust particles in the workplace, promoting a healthier and safer environment for employees while ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety regulations.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET-based Carry Lookahead Adder using GDI logic
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A FinFET-based Carry Lookahead Adder (CLA) using Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) logic is proposed, leveraging FinFET’s superior control over short-channel effects and reduced leakage currents to enhance CLA performance in arithmetic units. The integration of GDI logic minimizes transistors and interconnects, leading to significant improvements in speed, power consumption, and area efficiency compared to traditional CMOS designs. Simulations and comparative analyses demonstrate that the FinFET-based GDI CLA outperforms conventional CMOS CLA, providing a high-performance, low-power solution for modern VLSI systems. The design was further analyzed for temperature variations using Cadence Virtuoso.

articleTitle: A Pre-trained EfficientNetV2B0 Model for the Accurate classification of Fake and Real Images
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This study discovers the use of the EfficientNetV2-B0 model to discriminate between AIgenerated and real images. We utilized a comprehensive dataset of images created by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and real-world photos from publicly available sources like CIFAR-10 and ImageNet. The model was trained with these datasets using advanced preprocessing techniques and data augmentation to enhance its generalization capabilities. Over 20 epochs, the model demonstrated significant improvements in both training and validation accuracy, peaking at $\mathbf{9 9. 6 7 \%}$ training accuracy and 98.56% validation accuracy. Despite some fluctuations, the validation loss showed an overall downward trend, reflecting the model’s increasing proficiency in minimizing classification errors. The results indicate that the EfficientNetV2-B0 model is highly effective in identifying AI-generated images, achieving high accuracy, precision, and recall. This research underscores the potential of advanced deep learning models in addressing the growing challenge of differentiating between synthetic and real images, with implications for enhancing security and authenticity in digital media.

articleTitle: Multiplier Free FIR Filter Design using Array Product Generator and Multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The FIR filters are widely used in various fields of applications. FPGA implementation of FIR filter has a challenge of complexity and delay. This research study mainly concentrates on the FIR filter design using less resources on the FPGA. The main units in the FIR filter are adders and multipliers, so in order to optimize the overall hardware usage, we proposed a multiplier free design because multipliers are more complex. In general, systems are making their way for less power consumption, less hardware complexity, and less area design. The proposed system is a multiplier free unit; hence, there will be few resources to be utilized as mentioned above. Multiplexer (mux)-based computation sharing approaches and actions, such as memory access operations, distributed arithmetic techniques, and common subexpression sharing, are the operations that are shared commonly. Shift and add operations can be seen extensively in the system. Those are the operations used in the array product generator for the fundamental generation of coefficients, irrespective of multipliers. In contrast to conventional multiplexer (MUX)based approaches, the given structure significantly reduces hardware complexity. The concept of sharing the similar operations for all the filter weights offers potential enhancements to MUX-based filter techniques and multiplierless scenarios, improving the power efficiency of the system and making the circuit design in an easier way. This design becomes ideal for many less power consuming applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Telecom Customer Loyalty Through Churn Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving telecommunications sector, maintaining profitability and growth depends on customer retention. With the goal of identifying the critical elements influencing customer attrition and creating a useful predictive model, this study offers a thorough investigation of customer churn prediction using a telecom dataset. This study uses a dataset that contains a variety of client features, such as account details, demographic data, and service consumption trends. Here, the data preparation techniques are used to manage anomalies, missing values, and data normalisation. The study uses a range of machine learning methods to forecast churn, such as support vector machines, random forests, decision trees, logistic regression, and gradient boosting. Metrics including accuracy, then precision, also the recall, then F1 score, and also the area under the curve of receiver operating characteristic are used to assess each model’s performance (AUC-ROC). By use of cross-validation and hyperparameter adjustment, we guarantee the models’ resilience and generalizability. Significant churn predictors, including contract type, duration, monthly costs, and customer support interactions, are identified by our investigation. According to the research, month-to-month contract holders who have higher monthly fees and frequent contact with customer service are more likely to experience customer attrition. The model with the highest degree of prediction accuracy is the random forest, which has an AUC-ROC of 0.85, making it the best-performing model. This paper offers a useful foundation for putting churn prediction models into practice in addition to highlighting the important variables causing customer churn in the telecom industry. Telecom firms may lower churn rates by creating focused retention tactics, such personalised offers and better customer care, by proactively identifying at-risk clients. The findings highlight how crucial it is to use machine learning and data analytics to improve client retention and enable commercial success in the telecom sector.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Dog Breed Identification and Behaviour Analysis in Conversational AI Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study aims to develop an innovative system for dog breed and behavior identification using deep learning algorithms, integrated with ChatGPT API and Google Text-to-Speech (TTS) for enhanced user interaction. Leveraging advanced convolutional neural networks (CNNs) such as ResNet, Inception, and VGG16, the system accurately identifies dog breeds based on visual input. These models are trained on a comprehensive dataset of dog images to ensure high accuracy and robust performance in breed classification. This multi-faceted approach not only streamlines the process of identifying dog breeds and behaviors but also enhances user experience through seamless interaction and accessibility features. The CNN models ResNet, Inception, and VGG16 demonstrated their effectiveness in identifying dog breeds, with accuracies of $87 \%, 85 \%$, and $83 \%$ respectively. The project showcases the potential of combining state-of-the-art deep learning models with advanced AI and TTS technologies to create an intelligent, user-friendly system for dog enthusiasts, trainers, and veterinarians.

articleTitle: Transforming 2D to 3D Light: Bringing AutoCAD Drawings to Life with Dialux Shadows and Light
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study explores utilizing DIALUX lighting software to convert 2D AutoCAD drawings of an office space into realistic 3D environments showcasing light and shadows. With the click of a button, flat CAD floor plans can be populated with lights, shadows, material textures, and background views that completely transform them. This photorealistic transformation enables architects and designers to instantly visualize and evaluate how different lighting designs and placements will appear in the actual office. Rather than relying solely on abstract CAD plans, DIALUX gives specifiers the power to make lighting an integral part of the design process from inception. This paper provides guidelines for seamlessly connecting AutoCAD and DIALUX to rapidly iterate lighting schemes for enhanced 3D visualization of office spaces

articleTitle: Enhancing High-Density Fish Farming in a Biofloc System Through IoT Driven Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Aquaculture, particularly fish farming, has grown in popularity and profitability, especially with the adoption of biofloc technology, which requires precise water quality control to optimize fish health and productivity. This research proposes an economical, automated system to monitor critical parameters like $\mathbf{p H}\left(6.8-7.5\right.$), temperature ($25-28^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$), turbidity ($30-100 \mathrm{NTU}$), and dissolved oxygen ($5-7 \mathrm{mg} / \mathrm{L}$). Immediate intervention, such as water replacement, is necessary if these levels deviate from set standards. The system integrates various sensors connected to an ESP8266 NodeMCU microcontroller, which manages data collection and transmission to a Firebase database, enabling real-time remote monitoring through an IP address. On-site, an OLED screen displays current readings, while the ADS1115 ADC enhances sensor accuracy. Temperature compensation for $\mathbf{p H}$ and total dissolved solids (TDS) measurements is also included to improve data reliability. Observations will be gathered every three days over a month to analyse trends and validate the system’s effectiveness. This solution provides fish farmers with real-time insights, helping to maintain stable water conditions and enhance biofloc-based aquaculture operations.

articleTitle: Automatic Temperature Control in Calendering Process
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Textile calendaring is an important process for improving fabric quality. This is achieved by passing the cloth through hot rollers placed under high tension. The process smooths the texture and regulates the shrinkage to achieve superior fabric quality. This project proposes integrating a Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) to introduce a dynamic procedure for roller speed control that accommodates diverse cloth characteristics. The study varies the speed of the rollers based on the cloth material inserted. By harnessing advanced technology, our study aims to revolutionize textile manufacturing practices and set new standards for quality and excellence in end products.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Detection: A Machine Learning Approach for Early Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Lung cancer poses a significant health challenge, with early detection being crucial for better outcomes. Traditional diagnostic methods have limitations, leading to missed diagnoses. Machine learning offers promise in revolutionizing disease detection by leveraging data and advanced algorithms. This paper explores using machine learning for early lung cancer detection. Sophisticated algorithms enable accurate diagnostic systems, improving efficiency and scalability. Challenges like data quality and interpretability also need to be addressed. This study evaluates machine learning algorithms on real datasets to assess their effectiveness in clinical practice, contributing to the field of healthcare applications. We have found highest accuracy (96.77%), precision (98.33%), recall (98.33%) and F1-score (98.33%) in the Random Forest classifier.

articleTitle: A Python Streamlit APP For the Merec-Spotis MCDA Method: A Practical Use for Selecting Training Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research study investigates the use of a Python Streamlit App developed for the MEREC-SPOTIS Multicriteria Decision Aid (MCDA) method. To show the use of the tool, an analysis will be carried out on the acquisition of Lead in Fighter Trainer (LIFT) aircraft, for the Brazilian Air Force (FAB). In light of the recent acquisition of advanced fighter aircraft by the FAB, there’s a growing need to close the gap between the training aircraft that cadets fly in the academy, and the frontline fighter aircraft. By integrating the MCDA method, the app enables a systematic and transparent evaluation of multiple aircraft alternatives based on various criteria, such as cost, performance, and technological compatibility. Through a comprehensive analysis, the app generates a prioritized ranking of the alternatives, aiding decision-makers in making informed choices. This research demonstrates the practical application of the MCDA method in complex decision-making scenarios, highlighting its potential to support strategic planning and resource allocation in the defense sector.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Robot for Environment Monitoring based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)

authors.preferredName: K V S H Gayatri Sarman

abstract: Inventive ideas for ecological monitoring applications have been made easier by the incorporation of IoT (Internet of Things) technology into intelligent robotic systems. Based on IoT principles, the design and execution of an intelligent robot for environment monitoring has been proposed in this work. The developed model has wide range of sensors which are helpful in measuring different ecological factors like humidity, temperature, air quality, and pollution levels. The developed model utilizes IoT connectivity to gather data in real time from various sensors and sends it to a central cloud platform for analysis and display. The proposed model also has autonomous navigation skills, which enable it to go across both indoor and outdoor areas while gathering data in various locations. The suggested system provides a scalable and reasonably priced way to continuously monitor the environment, with possible uses in urban planning, agriculture, and disaster relief.

articleTitle: Comparative Image Analysis of Chest X-RAY Image Encryption using Symmetric and Asymmetric Key Encryption Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Assuring the medicinal data is very important for protecting the patient’s privacy and their trust in the team. Prohibited access to confidential medicinal data gives rise to privacy breaches, healthcare scams, and improper health treatment. The technique that is suggested offers an opportunity for the encryption of chest scan images. The approach makes use of a multilayer encryption mechanism that contains a hashing layer, a digital signature layer, and the final encryption layer. The utilization of multiple algorithms for the layers mentioned above is analyzed and contrasted. For the encryption of an image, two algorithms are used which are AES and DES. For creating a digital signature, RSA and DSS are utilized. For all the three methods mentioned, RSA Key Encryption and SHA-256 hash algorithm are been frequently used. As for the evaluation metrics for the three approaches, time and space complexities are computed. The methods mentioned above prove the CIA triad which is confidentiality, Integrity, and authentication of the chest X-ray images. The most effective approach proves to be AES image encryption with RSA digital signature as it takes a short amount of time to decrypt.

articleTitle: Performance Characterization and Link Budget Analysis for DVB-S2/S2X Waveform
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Satellite communication offers the advantages of ubiquitous coverage and last-mile connectivity. These advantages of SATCOM are further ameliorated when communication is established using DVB-S2/S2X waveform as it provides anexcellent spectral efficiency. However, in a practical scenario optimum communication link performance using satellite is achieved when myriad channel losses and system impairments are considered with appropriate link budgeting. An analysis to determine the sensitivity of DVBS2/S2X waveforms due to the effects of link budget parameters helps to characterize the baseband module. It will further aid in designing a robust DVB-S2/S2X based satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Floyd-Warshall Algorithm: Sequential and Parallel Execution Using Intel oneAPI
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The Floyd-Warshall algorithm is a widely utilized graph-based technique designed to address the all-pairs shortest path problem. However, its cubic time complexity $O\left(n^{3}\right)$ creates performance bottlenecks when applied to large graphs, especially in sequential execution. This paper explores the use of Intel oneAPI’s Data Parallel C++ (DPC++) programming model to optimize the performance of the Floyd-Warshall algorithm through parallel processing. A comparative performance analysis between sequential and parallel implementations on an Intel Xeon(R) CPU highlights up to a $43 \%$ improvement in execution time for graphs with 800 nodes. The results underscore the potential of parallel computing in significantly reducing computational time for large-scale graph algorithms.

articleTitle: UAV-based Solar Powered Animal and Human Health Monitoring and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The Motive of the “UAV-based Solar Powered Animal and Human Health Monitoring and Tracking” is to monitor the vitals of both animals and humans and track them if necessary. This method has proven that it is the most efficient and unthreatening way to mitigate any type of health risk to both animals and human beings. Considering the recent climate degradation and its resources, monitoring and tracking wildlife is necessary. The system is integrated with a pulse sensor, temperature sensor, GSM, and GPS, where the pulse sensor and temperature sensor collect and monitor the vitals of the body, and using the GSM an alert signal with the GPS co-ordinates is transmitted to the server or the ground station. The obtained GPS data is then processed using a Machine Learning algorithm where the GPS data is fed to the Mission Planner Software. UAV upon receiving the commands from the Mission Planner Server the UAV is navigated to the Distress Location and acts as an automated machine that can be used to collect and monitor the live conditions i.e., Surveillance at that distress location until the response team is sent to the place where distress signal is received, dropping medicines or food supplies with the help of UAVs. By using this mechanism, we can reduce any health risks by identifying the fluctuations in the vitals of both animals and humans so that this method can save many lives.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Visual Artistry: Exploring the Transformative Power of Computational Photography
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the past decade, there has been a significant shift in the way we consume and utilize visual media. The swift evolution in smartphone cameras has made photography and videography available to a large audience and the rise of social media has greatly boosted the influence of smartphone photography, making it an essential tool for amateurs and professionals alike. Computational photography - capture, enhancement and manipulation of images by digital computation, a field drawn from computer vision and image processing, lies at the core of this paradigm shift. This raises questions about whether smartphone cameras can truly rival traditional photography equipment. This paper reviews the field of Computational Photography, specifically its application in low-light imaging, dynamic range optimization, and bokeh effects, while drawing a comparison between photos captured by smartphones and DSLR.

articleTitle: AI and IoT-assisted Water Quality Monitoring and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research provides a strong and all-inclusive solution by utilizing the capabilities of Internet of Things and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies for water quality prediction. The system uses an Arduino that is integrated with Temperature, Turbidity, pH, total dissolved solids, and LCD sensors to record water quality data in real time. Cloud connectivity is provided via ESP8266, which allows the collected data to be sent to the cloud in an efficient manner. Here, the prediction of water quality levels is made possible by a Python script that uses AI techniques to compare the real-time data with an existing dataset. Over time, the prediction model adjusts and improves, guaranteeing accuracy. Following visualization, the data is shown in real-time on ThingSpeak, offering a simple and approachable platform for tracking trends in water quality. This integrated system is a sustainable method of using technology for environmental monitoring and prediction, while also improving the effectiveness of water resource management.

articleTitle: Automated Apple Wax Detection with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this work, the application of wax coatings on fruits is a widespread practice aimed at enhancing visual appeal and shelf life but raises concerns regarding consumer health and transparency. This study introduces an automated approach using IoT and machine learning to detect wax coatings on fruits. Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), we developed a robust system capable of accurately distinguishing between waxed and unwaxed apples. Our methodology involved collecting a comprehensive dataset, preprocessing images, and training the CNN to classify images based on wax presence. The system demonstrates high accuracy, validated through rigorous testing and comparison with existing methods. This research contributes to enhancing consumer transparency in food safety and sets a foundation for future applications in agricultural technology.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Use of Machine Learning to Enhance Online Digital Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Academic institutions’ interest in online learning is rising at an exponential rate due to the rapid advancement of expertise. The Learning Management System (LMS) is a key component of the online learning architecture and is also used to mine student data. This study reviews and analyses the literature on machine learning (ML) in online education and machine learning integrated learning management systems (LMS). The goal of this study is to comprehend the different efforts made to employ different ML techniques to lessen the difficulties associated with online learning environments, or online LMSs. Increasing student performance by projecting future grades is just one of several obstacles. Other issues that can be resolved using machine learning include student retention and behavior analysis for performance enhancement. The paper presents the research that different authors have done in the relevant topic. The chosen time frame for the project remains close to the Covid19 years.

articleTitle: Warehouse Management in Chemical and Textile Industry using Internet of Things (IoT) And Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Inventory management involves overseeing and controlling goods flow, ensuring availability, and minimizing costs. Effective management improves efficiency, reduces expenses, and increases profitability while meeting customer demand and satisfaction. This study aims to develop an automatic warehouse management system for the chemical and textile industry. It utilizes Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology, revolutionizing warehouse management by providing real-time tracking and inventory management. RFID enables automatic identification without line-of-sight scanning, increasing efficiency and accuracy. Tagged items are continuously tracked, ensuring real-time visibility and faster order fulfilment. RFID automates inventory management, reducing manual counting and errors, improving accuracy, reducing stock-outs, and enhancing order fulfilment rates. It also improves supply chain visibility, reducing delays, and improving efficiency. RFID technology offers significant advantages over barcode scanning, including efficiency, accuracy, and supply chain visibility. Thus, RFID is increasingly popular for warehouse management in various industries, providing substantial benefits.

articleTitle: Empowering Visual Interaction: Raspberry Pi 4 and OLED Displays for Dynamic Feedback Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The advent of compact OLED displays has spurred interest in their integration with the Raspberry Pi 4 platform, promising dynamic visual feedback in a multitude of applications. The Raspberry Pi 4, distinguished for its computational power, harmonizes effortlessly with high-resolution OLED display technology, establishing a formidable foundation for real-time data presentation, status monitoring, and interactive user interfaces. This study offers guidance on the hardware setup, software configuration, and code implementation for researchers, developers, and enthusiasts. Through systematic experimentation and detailed analysis, this research showcases the effectiveness and promise of this integration, endowing users with intuitive data comprehension and interactive engagement. Furthermore, the paper examines the far-reaching implications and potential applications of this integration, encompassing diverse domains like Internet of Things (IoT) deployments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Voltage Regulation System with GSM Integration and Enhanced Disaster Mitigation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: An innovative device called the PV-VVR is made to guard against power outages and variations in voltage in low-voltage home distribution systems. When the photovoltaic system generates enough electricity to meet or exceed residential demand, usually during the day, it disconnects from the utility grid, ensuring stable voltage levels and enhancing energy independence. This innovation reduces emissions, which not only increases power supply dependability but also advances environmental sustainability. The PV-VVR is an affordable option for incorporating renewable energy into home systems because it also helps to reduce panel tariff expenses.

articleTitle: Enhancing Visual Clarity via Color Model-Based Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach for enhancing hazy images using histogram methods and color space conversions. The method involves converting the hazy image into RGB, HSV, and YCbCr color spaces, where each space offers unique insights into the image’s color and brightness characteristics. By applying histogram equalization and other histogram-based techniques in these color spaces, the hazy image is effectively dehazed, resulting in improved contrast, color balance, and visibility of details. The RGB representation provides a straightforward interpretation of color intensity, while the HSV model separates hue, saturation, and value components, enabling targeted adjustments. Additionally, the YCbCr color space separates luminance and chrominance, offering further flexibility in image enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in mitigating haze and enhancing image quality across various scenes and lighting conditions. Overall, the integration of histogram methods with color space conversions presents a robust approach for addressing hazy conditions and improving image visibility. Experimental findings indicate that the suggested strategy is successful at reducing haze and improving image quality over a wide range of situations and lighting conditions. Overall, combining histogram approaches with color space conversions provides a strong strategy to tackling foggy situations and boosting picture visibility.

articleTitle: Classification of Different Stages of Eczema Disease using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Skin diseases pose significant challenges in both diagnosis and treatment due to their diverse manifestations and complexities. In recent years, the advancement of deep learning techniques has revolutionized medical image analysis, offering promising avenues for automated detection and categorization of dermatological conditions. The primary focus of this system is the detection of different stages of the skin disease “Eczema” using YOLO model and will be integrated with mobile application. Our methodology entails training the YOLOv8 model on a dataset encompassing 3000 diverse instances of Eczema at various stages. The model undergoes fine-tuning to discern distinctive visual patterns corresponding to different phases of the skin condition. Subsequently, the trained YOLOv8 model is deployed for real-time inference on new images, enabling prompt and reliable identification of Eczema stages. Post-collection, the dataset undergoes labelling to categorically define the various stages of eczema. Performance evaluation of this model demonstrates a commendable accuracy rate of approximately 81.9%, reflecting its robustness in identifying different stages of Eczema.

articleTitle: Enhanced 16 × 16 Dadda Multiplier Using Kung-Brent Adder for Superior Parallel Processing Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This study presents a refined 16x16 Dadda multiplier optimized for parallel processing applications, integrating the Kung-Brent adder to enhance performance. By combining the Dadda multiplier’s efficient partial product reduction with the Kung-Brent adder’s reduced delay and area overhead, the design achieves notable improvements in power efficiency and speed. The use of parallel processing at multiple stages further accelerates computation, ensuring high throughput and low latency. Our thorough simulation and synthesis results demonstrate that this optimized multiplier surpasses traditional designs in key performance indicators, including speed, area, and efficiency. The enhanced design is particularly effective for high-demand parallel processing tasks and offers significant advancements in digital circuit design. This development not only provides a robust solution for efficient arithmetic operations but also paves the way for future innovations in digital multiplier technologies.

articleTitle: Advanced Bird Species Classification using Self-Attention and GAN-based Data Augmentation on BIRDS 525 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Accurately categorizing bird species in fine-grained picture collections remains a difficult challenge due to considerable visual similarity across species and modest intra-class variances. This research presents a sophisticated bird species categorization system based on Vision Transformers (ViTs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), which was evaluated on the BIRDS 525 dataset. Vision Transformers are used to replace typical convolutional neural networks (CNNs), utilizing their superior self-attention processes to record intricate visual features including feather textures, color gradients, and shape variances. To address the limits imposed by the short dataset size, StyleGAN2 is employed to produce high-quality synthetic images, improving the model’s capacity to generalize across different species. Experiments show that the ViT based model has an improved performance with respect to classification over CNN based approaches when combining GAN generated pictures and audio data. Our study shows the potential of Vision Transformers in fine-grained classification tasks with advanced data augmentation strategies.

articleTitle: Blockchain Secured Energy Trading for Grid Connected Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The renewable energy sources become a larger part of the power grid, managing their intermittent nature is of utmost significance. Blockchain technology provides secure and transparent path for energy trading to individuals directly with each other (peer-to-peer) in these systems. Proposed work gives a framework to monitor blockchain-based energy trading, where it tracks the parameters like how much energy is being generated and used, along with the details of trades recorded on the blockchain. It also monitors how well the automated trading agreements (smart contracts) are working and how fast the entire system is running. By keeping an eye on these aspects, the framework can help ensure this new way of trading energy with renewables is secure, transparent, and efficient.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Detection and Delineation Sound in Smart City System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: For many years, sound delineation has been a prominent area of research. Human speech is the basis for sound categorization models and sophisticated sound recognition systems features related to hearing. There are limitless applications for those traits, such as context awareness, criminal detection, and surveillance systems. In classifying audio dataset, it is proven to be highly effective convolutional neural network among the types of deep learning model. In order to do this, it describes sound files using the spectral contrast, chromogram, tonal centroid, and mel spectrogram as their picture representations, and then use these representations to train the deep learning model. The final outcome, especially considering the dataset’s characteristics and the fact that classifying ambient noises is considerably more difficult than classifying speech and music. The findings of the experiment likewise demonstrate a significant improvement in accuracy between the deep learning technique so that can be incorporated in surveillance system to delineation sound in crime environment in Smart City System.

articleTitle: Evolving Patterns: A CNN Approach to Butterfly Species Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Identification of several types of butterflies determines both ecological study and conservation of biodiversity. Conventional classification methods based on hand identification are time-consuming, subjective, prone to mistakes because of the enormous variety of butterfly species and visual similarities among them. This research explores high accuracy automated butterfly classification using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Training the CNN model on a varied collection of butterfly photos using cutting-edge preprocessing methods including image scaling, normalisation, and data augmentation helped to improve model resilience. The architecture which comprised numerous convolutional, pooling, and fully connected layers optimized with the Adam algorithm. The model evaluated with accuracy of 94.9%, much above widely accepted norms using measurements of precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy. Although this success, problems such intra class variability, class imbalance, and inter class similarities still exist. This paper highlights CNN’s outstanding accuracy in butterfly classification and offers an automated, fast method for ecological monitoring. Future studies could overcome these challenges and broaden the approach to identify newly discovered environments and species.

articleTitle: Contribution of doping concentration of the Perovskite layer to the optimization of solar cell efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This study tries to observe the Perovskite PV cell efficiency taking consideration of doping density. The Perovskite layer ($\mathbf{P}$-layer) is a very significant layer for the optimization of the PV cell efficiency. From analysis of simulation, it is seen that the energy transformation efficiency is highly affected by the doping density of the P-layer. The maximum efficiency that has been obtained is 36.82% for the acceptor density of $1.0 \times 10^{27} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$. And, the fill factor obtained for this doping concentration is 91.30%. Voc, MPP voltage are also recorded highest for this doping density, though the Isc density and MPP current have been declined to a low key extent of order.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation using Mini Batch K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Today, especially in this era of data, everything is becoming more mechanized. Data is the new electricity of the globe. This knowledge may help a lot of businesses in their marketing endeavors. Every business wanted to flourish and outperform its rivals, so they spent in product development and used novel ideas, but only to retain and grow their consumer base. In today’s business environment, consumers are separated. They can help them make money by analyzing the actions and buying habits of their customers. Customer segmentation is the process of grouping a company’s customers according to their shared characteristics. Client segmentation is the process of figuring out how to communicate with customers in various categories to increase the value of each client to the business. To segment customers, unsupervised machine learning is employed. The main objective of this research study is to cluster consumers into different groups based on their behavior patterns. There are several algorithms that may segment customers depending on their behavior and other criteria. Five clustering algorithms were examined in this study, and the best one was chosen for more investigation.

articleTitle: Analyzing Algorithms: A Comparative Study of Book Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the era of digital libraries and online bookstores, efficient recommendation systems are crucial for helping users discover relevant books. This research investigates the performance of various machine learning algorithms, including Decision Trees, Random Forests, K-Nearest Neighbors, Linear Regression, Ridge Regression, RANSAC Regression, Gradient Boosting, LightGBM, and XGBoost, in predicting user preferences. The study evaluates the performance of these algorithms using metrics such as Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and R -squared. By analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of each approach, the research provides insights into the most suitable algorithms for different recommendation scenarios.The findings of this research can guide developers and researchers in designing and implementing effective book recommendation systems. By understanding the limitations and potential of various machine learning techniques, it is possible to create personalized and engaging reading experiences for users.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models in Bone Tumor Diagnosis: Performance Evaluation and Hyperparameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Bone tumor is a very severe condition, it can be benign or malignant. Provides major difficulties in medical diagnosis. For diverse kinds of bone cancers, conventional diagnostic techniques including physical exams and plain radiography often fall short. Although useful, advanced imaging methods such as MRIs and CT scans still have restrictions because of interpretation problems and professional variances. Then correct treatment and better patient outcomes can be helpful in early and precise diagnosis, by using distinct Machine Learning approaches diagnosis might be improved by early prediction of bone tumors. This work investigates distinct methods of Machine Learning, such as XGBoost, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Random Forest (RF) classifiers. To improve model performance, the work also optimizes the hyperparameters using grid search. The results showed that hyperparameter adjustment greatly raised accuracy. Grid search gave an accuracy of $85 \%$, this study underlines how Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning could solve the shortcomings of conventional diagnosis techniques and raise the precision and efficiency of bone tumor identification.

articleTitle: Ovarian Cancer Detection using Microarray gene data and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Ovarian cancer, is one of the most common gynecologic problem, that poses a severe threat to women’s health. Since there are tens of thousands of genes in the microarray data for ovarian cancer, it is extremely Challenge to detect the disease. Reducing computational complexity by selecting the most relevant genes is crucial due to the limited sample size and high dimensionality of these datasets. In this research, the ANOVA method is applied for initial gene selection during the preprocessing stage. Next, performing statistical parameter analysis to gain insights into the dataset. Feature selection and dimensionality reduction are conducted using a Genetic Algorithm to optimize gene selection. For prediction, a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) is employed to classify normal and abnormal samples. Finally, the performance of the model is evaluated through comprehensive metrics analysis. This workflow is designed to improve the accuracy and efficiency of ovarian cancer detection by focusing on the most informative genes and utilizing advanced Deep learning techniques. This proposed methodology is achieved the accuracy with 85.93% demonstrating that the integration of GA for feature optimization with GCN for classification significantly improves detection performance compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Handwritten Digit Recognition: Insights into CNN and RNN Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Automated form processing and digitalized document management are only two applications for the crucial skill of handwriting number recognition. It is investigated how neural networks and sequential models may be used to recognize handwritten numbers. This is an important problem that has many uses, such as automated form processing and digital document management. After a brief review of the historical relevance of handwritten digit identification, the paper delves into the fundamental ideas of sequential models and neural networks. In particular, CNNs and RNNs are utilized to explore how well they can represent the temporal and spatial correlations present in handwritten numbers. Important preprocessing methods to improve model performance are covered, including data augmentation and normalization. There are several neural network designs shown, highlighting CNNs for processing sequential data and RNNs for extracting spatial features. To ensure consistent model performance, optimization methods, evaluation metrics, and training strategies are examined. Additionally, challenges related to scalability and the diversity of handwriting styles are addressed. The CNN model achieved a high training accuracy of 99.82%.

articleTitle: Empowering Tomorrow’s Cities: Navigating Power Challenges through Deep Learning Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This review, titled “Empowering Tomorrow’s Cities: Navigating Power Challenges through Deep Learning Solutions,” explores the intersection of power management issues and the trans-formative potential of deep learning technologies. It addresses the growing challenges of energy consumption, grid reliability, and peak demand, emphasizing deep learning’s vital role in optimizing power usage. The article provides a detailed overview of smart cities, highlighting the importance of efficient power management for their continued development. By presenting deep learning as a groundbreaking solution, it examines its applications in real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and demand forecasting. Through case studies, the review showcases successful deep learning implementations in tackling specific power challenges. It also explores the integration of IoT with deep learning, emphasizing their synergy in advancing data-driven decision-making. Critical aspects like data security and privacy are discussed, ensuring a thoughtful approach to managing sensitive data for optimized power distribution. Looking ahead, the article envisions future trends and innovations, stressing the need for ongoing research to fully harness deep learning in addressing power challenges in smart cities.

articleTitle: Electrooculography Based Automated Wheel Chair for Paralysed Person
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The automated wheelchair with Electrooculography (EOG) is a financially viable way to improve mobility for people with paralysis or physical impairments. The wheelchair’s movements are then controlled by this system by means of the detection and interpretation of ocular movements through the use of EOG technology. Sensors collect eye movement data, which are then processed by a microcontroller that uses a battery source to power the motors. By giving users, the ability to use their wheelchair for everyday tasks like eating and traveling, this creative method greatly increases their independence and enhances their quality of life overall.

articleTitle: Categorization and Recognition of Pest in Crops and Remedial action for Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Plant-related diseases and insects can seriously harm a plant’s quality and productivity. Plant diseases and pests can be identified using digital image processing. Recent advances in the research of image processing have demonstrated deep learning has significantly surpassed more traditional methods in this regard. Scientist are currently exploring that how deep learning techniques could enhance the identification of plant diseases and pests. This paper outlines the claims integrated with analysing pests and plant pathogens and evaluates and compares the various diagnostic techniques currently in use. This article summarizes three viewpoints from latest research on deep learning implemented in plant disease and pest detection, each based on a distinct network design. Recognising pest-borne diseases with a convolutional neural network (CNN) driven methodology using Dataset. In identifying pests by comparing its effectiveness with other existing methods. The CNN models, which were trained exclusively on the pest dataset, scored an impressive accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 6 6 \%}$.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Image Processing for Early Detection of Stripe Rust in Wheat Crops using CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research proposes a novel approach utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for the early detection of stripe rust (Puccinia striiformis) diseases in wheat crops. The study focuses on leveraging image processing techniques and deep learning concepts to analyze leaf images, identifying characteristic yellow stripes of pustules caused by the fungus Puccinia striiformis f.sp. tritici. The CNN model, a key component of the research, is intricately designed to capture and learn intricate patterns associated with stripe rust, offering a proactive solution to mitigate its impact. The methodology encompasses preprocessing steps, convolutional and pooling layers, and fully connected layers to enhance the model’s predictive capabilities. Evaluation metrics, including accuracy, sensitivity, precision, recall, and $F 1$ score, demonstrate promising results with an overall accuracy of $86 \%$. The research emphasizes the importance of suitable variety selection, seed and fertilizer treatments, and timely fungicide application as part of an integrated disease management strategy. Limitations, future enhancements, and practical recommendations for farmers are also discussed, emphasizing the significance of removing volunteer wheat plants and selecting resistant varieties. The proposed CNN model stands as a promising tool for precision agriculture, aiding in the timely and efficient management of stripe rust in wheat crops.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Commerce Security: A Machine Learning Framework for Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A business paradigm known as electronic commerce, or e-commerce, enables businesses and individuals to purchase and sell anything over the internet. Since frauds been for a long and erratic and lack consistency, it might be challenging to spot them. The drastic changes are exploited by con artists. Huge looses are been occurred due a result of their devious manipulation of security checks. An increase in internet customers is contributing to a spike in transactions. We note that deception is becoming more common in online transactions as well. The use of device learning in online commerce will increase to prevent deception. This research looks into machine learning methods for detecting an fraud for various e-commerce, with a particular emphasis on decision trees, RF, and Neural Net. Based on a dataset of 149,156 records—13,962 of which are flagged as fraudulent—obtained from Kaggle, the study applies a quantitative methodology to assess categorization results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of AI-Driven Biomedical Image Processing for Intracerebral Hemorrhage Detection and Classification: Current Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Amongst many life-threatening conditions, a fatal condition is the Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). It may result in death if not treated immediately and hence necessitates the need for accurate diagnosis for effective treatment. In recent times, concepts of Artificial intelligence (AI), have emerged as a transformative tool in medical image processing, offering faster and more reliable ICH detection and classification. This research study reviews the current advancements in AI-driven biomedical image processing for ICH, exploring various state-of-the-art models involving Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), variants of CNN with more efficient feature extraction procedures, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and optimization methods like Genetic Algorithms (GA), Ant Colony Model (ACO), rParticle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Additionally, challenges such as data scarcity, model interpretability, and generalization across diverse populations are discussed. The paper highlights future research directions, including the need for explainable AI, multimodal data integration, and real-time, low-cost AI solutions for resourceconstrained environments. By addressing these challenges, AI has the potential to revolutionize ICH detection and improve patient outcomes globally.

articleTitle: Edge based Device using Machine Learning for Water Quality Management in a Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Water contamination is a serious threat imposed with the increased population in a smart city environment. Industrial wastes, leakage from sewage systems, floods and runoff from agriculture disrupt ecosystems and threaten sustainable development. Water quality monitoring is mandate in a smart campus for immediate identification and response, thereby avoiding health issues to the inmates. Manual checking of water quality involves sending water samples for laboratory analysis, which is done on collected samples and not real time. Hence, an attempt is made to provide monitoring of quality drinking water in a smart campus environment through Internet of Things. Sensors continuously gathers data on vital indicators including pH, turbidity, conductivity and total dissolved solids. The collected data is analysed using Decision Tree Machine Learning algorithm running on a central Raspberry Pi which forecasts the likelihood of crossing safety thresholds and even the potability of the water. Also, the real-time updates on the condition of water are provided via a mobile app. Based on the predictions, the authorities can take appropriate actions, such as identifying the origins of contamination or streamlining treatment procedures. Thus, a methodology for safeguarding public health is guaranteed through the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Retinal Fundus in Diabetic Retinopathy using Modern Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of vision loss worldwide. Early detection and timely intervention are crucial for preventing vision impairment. This research aims to develop an AI-powered system for the early detection of Diabetic Retinopathy using fundus images.
